en.name: Facing Pages from a Manuscript of the Qur'an
description: In the second half of the sixteenth century especially, Shiraz was an important hub for the creation of large-format luxury manuscripts of the Qur’an, some of which were intended for export to the Ottoman Empire. This pair of facing pages from the closing section of a dispersed manuscript includes the *du‘a al-khatm*, or prayer said at the conclusion of a reading of the Qur’an; it is preceded by the closing verses of the Qur’an, and followed by a *falnama*, (a Persian versified form of divination). The beautiful decoration framing the gold calligraphy of the khatm prayer epitomizes the Shiraz style of illumination in its colorful exuberance. The recto of the right-hand page is comprised of Suras 113-114 indicating that the full text must have similarly composed of large lines of blue *muhaqqaq* and gold *thuluth* alternating with blocks of smaller *naskh* in black on gold-sprinkled paper, framed by panels of scrolling floral illumination, the sura headings in white on gold and polychrome illuminated panels, marginal roundels marking various points in the text. Numerous similarly decorated manuscripts of the Qur’an are preserved in Istanbul collections, demonstrating a distinct Turkish affinity for the Shiraz style.
holder: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)
dates: Hegira c. third quarter 10th century / AD c. third quarter 16th century
keywords: Manuscript; ink; gold; Iran; Safavid; Qur'an; calligraphy; prayer; divination; thuluth; floral motifs
materials: Ink, colors, and gold on paper
tags: Ink, colors, and gold on paper
partner: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)

en.name: Maktab Anbar
description: Maktab Anbar is situated in the historic al-Kharrab quarter of Damascus. Its construction began in 1867 as the private home of Yusuf Anbar, a wealthy Damascene Jewish merchant. Designed as an extensive courtyard  Damascene residence with richly decorated interiors, but the building remained unfinished because financial difficulties forced its owner to relinquish the property, which subsequently passed into Ottoman government ownership. During the late 1880s, the Ottoman authorities adapted the residence into a government preparatory school, officially known as Maktab al-Iedadiyya al-Malakiyya (Royal Preparatory School). The adaptation was part of an educational reform of the late Ottoman Empire, which expanded state schooling and introduced some institutions intended to prepare students for administrative and professional careers. The school's curriculum included languages and scientific subjects alongside other areas of instruction. During the twentieth century, the building served other purposes before it was restored and adapted for Civic and municipal functions; it now accommodates the Old Damascus Citizen Service Centre and the headquarters of the Committee for the Protection of Old Damascus.
keywords: Damascus; Maktab Anbar; Education; Secondary schools; Damascene architecture; Courtyard houses
partner: Ministry of Culture, Directorate General of Museums and Antiquities

ar.name: المسجد الكبير.
description:
يُظهر المسجد الكبير أوجه شبه قريبة من مخطط الجامع الأموي في دمشق. يشغل المسجد والفناء والمدرسة الدينية المجاورة له مساحة قدرها 75 متراً مربعاً. الجانب الغربي من الفناء مربع الأضلاع غير مستوٍ بسبب تلف أحد ممراته الأساسية. تقع قاعة الصلاة جنوب الفناء، ويحيط كلاً من جانبيها الغربي والشرقي رواق ذو طابقين. من جهة الشمال، يوجد مسجد الشافعيين (المذهب الشافعي أحد مذاهب الإسلام السنة) الصغير والمدرسة المسعودية، ويفصل بينهما ممر ضيق. يبلغ طول قاعة الصلاة 75 متراً وعرضها 17 متراً من الخارج. وتقع المئذنة بجوار الحائط الجنوبي من الخارج. يعلو المئذنة البرجية المربعة مقطع أسطواني يتوجه سقف مخروطي الشكل.  
  
تتكون قاعة الصلاة من ثلاثة أجنحة ممتدة من الشرق إلى الغرب، ويفصل بينها صفان من الأعمدة، قياس كل عمود 90x 115 سم. في وسط قاعة الصلاة المستطيلة جناح معترض بعرض 11 متراً تقريباً، ينتهي عند المحراب والمنبر من جهة الجنوب. أما سقف قاعة الصلاة، الذي يعلوه سقف الجناح المعترض، فمطلي بطبقة من القار، بينما السطح الخارجي مكسو بصفائح من الرصاص. الواجهة الشمالية لقاعة الصلاة مزخرفة بأكاليل زهر ورسوم متموجة. القنطرة المخددة الموجودة فوق عتبة أحد الممرات محاطة بكوتين على شكل محراب مع أعمدة موشورية صغيرة معشَّقة وصدفات محار، وفي أعلى الجدران ثمة إفريز من حجر البازلت.  
  
يشتمل الرواق الشرقي بطابقيه على أعمدة ذات تيجان كورنثية. وفي حين أن أعمدة القسم العلوي مكونة من قطعة واحدة، وجميعها مزخرفة بأشكال هندسية مختلفة، فإن الأعمدة السفلية تتألف من أسطوانتين أو ثلاثة وبأحجام متنوعة. على خلاف الجناح الشرقي، فإن الجناح الغربي مزين بحلى معمارية بارزة على الجوانب الخارجية لعقود الصف السفلي. يوجد على المساحات المثلثية للبوابة الشرقية للفناء لوحتان لحيوانات تتصارع، منحوتتان بشكل بارز ومتناسق؛ وفي وسط اللوحة المنحوتة على قنطرة المدخل ثمة نقش لأسد محطم الرأس، أما الإطار الزخرفي المحيط بعتبة الباب فقد رسمت عليه أشكال سعفية. وقد نفذت الرسوم الزخرفية داخل قاعة الصلاة خلال الترميم في عام 1124/ 1712. استخدم في بناء المسجد بعض قطع تعود للعهدين الروماني والبيزنطي؛ فالتيجان، والكتل الحجرية التي تشكل الأفاريز، وبعض الأطر الزخرفية، ربما ترقى إلى القرن 4 م. وباستثناء إعادة استخدام المواد القديمة، من الواضح أن المبنى بكامله قد بني في العهد الإسلامي. ومع ذلك، هناك تضارب واضح بين أقسامه من حيث تنوع الأنماط التاريخية. الواجهات الخارجية للجدران مكسوّة بحجر البازلت مع حواف كلسية هنا وهناك. لقد شيِّد المبنى كمسجد في الأساس، ولا يزال يستخدم مكاناً للعبادة حتى الآن.
keywords: ديار بكر؛ زخرفة تصويرية؛ سلب؛ مسجد.

en.name: Great Mosque (Ulu Cami).
description:
The Great Mosque of Diyarbakır shows close parallels with the layout of the Umayyad Mosque in Damascus. The mosque, together with its courtyard and the adjoining theological school (*madrasa*), covers a square area of approximately 75 m. The western side of the quadrangular courtyard is uneven due to the loss of an original alleyway. The prayer hall is located to the south of the courtyard, which is flanked by two-storied porticoes on the west and east. On the north, separated from one another by a narrow passageway, are the *Masjid* (small mosque) of the Shafi'is (a sect of Sunni Islam) and the Mesudiye Madrasa. The prayer hall is 75 m long and 17 m wide on the outside. The minaret adjoins the southern wall on the outside. The square, tower-like minaret is crowned with a cylindrical section and a conical roof.  
The prayer hall has three aisles running east to west, separated from each other by two rows of piers, each measuring 90 cm x 115 cm. The oblong prayer hall has an almost 11-m wide transverse aisle in the middle, terminating in the south at the *mihrab* and the *minbar*. The prayer hall is covered with a pitched roof, with the roof of the transverse aisle rising above it. The roof's exterior is sheathed with lead plates. The northern façade of the prayer hall is decorated with garland and meander motifs. The pointed arch above the lintel of one of the doorways is flanked with two small *mihrab* niches with prismatic engaged colonnettes and oyster-shell conches. On top of the walls is an eave built of basalt.  
The two-storied eastern portico of the courtyard has columns with Corinthian capitals on each storey. While the upper columns are single units, the lower ones are formed of two or three shafts of varying sizes. In contrast to the eastern wing, the western wing has mouldings on the outer sides of the arches of the lower tier. All the columns of the upper storey are single units decorated with various geometric motifs.  
On the spandrels of the eastern gate to the courtyard are two animal combat scenes, carved symmetrically in relief. In the middle of the inscription panel above the doorway arch is a damaged carving of a lion's head, and the decorative band framing the entryway has palmette motifs. The painted decoration inside the prayer hall was done during the restoration of AH 1124 / AD 1712.  
The mosque makes use of spolia that dates to the Roman and Byzantine periods. The Corinthian capitals, the blocks forming the eaves and some of the decorative bands can be dated to the 4th century AD. Apart from the re-used ancient materials, it is clear that the entire structure was built in the Islamic period; however, there is an apparent clash of historical styles among its sections.  
The outer faces of the walls are faced with basalt with bands of limestone here and there.  
The structure was originally built as a mosque and is still used as a place of worship today.

The Great Mosque of Diyarbakır with its transverse aisle and courtyard is one of the most important early Islamic monuments erected in Anatolia. The floral and geometric decorations on the eastern and western porticoes of the courtyard as well as the figurative decorations flanking the eastern portal are important evidence for a Turkish–Islamic synthesis. Some of the decorations are found on Roman and Byzantine spolia that have been reused.
dates: Hegira first half of the 5th century / AD 11th century.
keywords: Diyarbakır; mosque; figurative decoration; spolia.

es.name: Mezquita Mayor (Ulu Cami).
description:
La traza de la Mezquita Mayor de Diyarbakir muestra grandes paralelismos con la de la mezquita omeya de Damasco. La mezquita en su conjunto, con el patio y la madrasa adyacente, cubre una superficie aproximada de 75 m2. El lado oeste del patio cuadrangular es irregular debido a la desaparición de uno de los pasajes originales. La sala de oración, que se abre en el lado sur del patio, está flanqueada al oeste y al este por pórticos de dos niveles. En la zona norte, separada por un estrecho pasaje, están el *masyid* (pequeña mezquita) de los shafiíes (una secta sunní) y la madrasa Mesudiye. El exterior de la sala de oración mide 75 metros de largo por 17 de ancho. El alminar se alza junto al muro sur; es cuadrado, similar a una torre y coronado con una sección cilíndrica y un tejado cónico.  
La sala de oración presenta tres naves orientadas de este a oeste, separadas por dos filas de pilares de 90 × 115 cm cada uno. En mitad de esta sala alargada hay una nave transversal de casi once metros de ancho que culmina en el muro sur, donde se encuentran el *mihrab* y el *minbar*. La cubierta es un tejado a dos aguas, revestido de placas de plomo, y en él sobresale el de la nave transversal. La fachada norte de la sala de oración está decorada con guirnaldas y motivos sinuosos. El arco apuntado sobre el dintel de una de las entradas está flanqueado por dos pequeños nichos con columnitas prismáticas unidas y conchas. Sobre los muros hay un alero de basalto.  
El pórtico al este del patio presenta columnas con capiteles corintios en sus dos niveles. Las columnas superiores son de una sola pieza, pero las inferiores están compuestas por dos o tres fustes de diversos tamaños. A diferencia del ala oriental, la occidental presenta molduras en las caras externas de los arcos de la hilera inferior. Todas las columnas del nivel superior están decoradas con motivos geométricos.  
En las albanegas de la puerta oriental del patio se aprecian dos luchas simétricas entre animales esculpidas en relieve. En medio de la inscripción del panel que hay sobre el arco de la entrada hay una deteriorada cabeza de león tallada. La entrada está enmarcada por una banda decorativa con palmetas. La decoración pintada del interior de la sala de oración se realizó durante la restauración de 1124 / 1712.  
En la construcción de la mezquita se reutilizaron materiales procedentes de edificios de época romana y bizantina. Los capiteles corintios, los bloques de los aleros y algunas bandas decorativas datan del siglo IV d. C. Al margen de estos materiales antiguos, resulta evidente que la estructura se construyó en época islámica, a pesar de la disparidad de estilos históricos que se aprecia entre distintas zonas. Las caras exteriores de las paredes están recubiertas de basalto y presentan bandas de piedra caliza en algunos sitios. El edificio se construyó originalmente como mezquita y aún hoy sigue siendo un lugar destinado al culto.

La Mezquita Mayor de Diyarbakır, con su patio y su nave transversal, es uno de los monumentos de principios de la época islámica más importantes de Anatolia. La decoración floral y geométrica de los pórticos oriental y occidental del patio, así como la decoración figurativa que rodea el portal oriental, ponen de manifiesto la síntesis turco-islámica. Parte de la decoración se realizó sobre materiales romanos y bizantinos reutilizados.
dates: Primera mitad del sigo V de la Hégira / siglo XI d. C.
keywords: Diyarbakır; mezquita; decoración figurativa; material reutilizado.

fr.name: Grande Mosquée (Ulu Cami).
description:
Le plan de la Grande Mosquée de Diyarbakir présente des liens étroits avec celui de la mosquée omeyyade de Damas. Avec sa cour et son école de théologie adjacente (*madrasa*), elle occupe un carré de 75 m de côté environ. Le côté ouest de la cour est inégal à la suite de la suppression d'un passage. La salle de prière située au sud de la cour est flanquée de portiques à deux niveaux à l'ouest et à l'est. Au nord, séparés par un étroit passage, se trouvent la petite mosquée (*masjid*) des shafiites (secte sunnite) et la *madrasa* Mesudiye. La salle de prière mesure 75 m de long sur 47 de large (murs extérieurs). La tour carrée du minaret extérieur, s'achevant en une section cylindrique et une toiture conique, est adjacente au mur sud de la mosquée.  
La salle de prière allongée possède trois nefs orientées est-ouest et séparées par deux rangées de piliers de 90 x 115 cm de base. Elle se compose d'une partie centrale et d'une nef transversale de près de 11 m de large s'achevant au sud par le *mihrab* et le *minbar*. Elle est abritée par une toiture à double pente en plaques de plomb, celle de l'aile transversale étant plus élevée. La façade nord est décorée de guirlandes et de motifs sinueux. L'arc brisé au-dessus du linteau de l'une des embrasures de porte est flanqué de deux petites niches de *mihrab* à colonnettes prismatiques engagées et coquille. Au sommet du mur se trouve un avant-toit en basalte.  
Les colonnes des deux niveaux du portique sont à chapiteaux corinthiens. Celles du niveau supérieur ne possèdent qu'un seul fût, celles du bas deux ou trois fûts de tailles variées. Par contraste avec l'aile est, l'aile ouest est ornée de moulures sur les faces extérieures des arcs de la partie inférieure. Toutes les colonnes de l'étage sont à fût unique orné de divers motifs géométriques.  
Sur les écoinçons de la porte orientale donnant sur la cour figurent des scènes symétriques de combats d'animaux sculptés en bas-relief. Au centre de l'inscription au-dessus de l'arc de la porte se remarque une tête de lion endommagée. Le bandeau ornemental encadrant l'entrée est à motifs de palmettes. Le décor peint de la salle de prière a été réalisé lors de la rénovation de 1124 H / 1712 J.-C.  
On trouve dans la mosquée des *spolia* des périodes romaines et byzantines. Les chapiteaux corinthiens, les blocs formant les avant-toits et certains bandeaux décoratifs sont datables du IVe siècle J.-C. En dehors de cette réutilisation de matériaux anciens, il est évident que la construction date entièrement de la période islamique, non sans oppositions entre les styles historiques des différentes parties.  
Les faces des murs extérieurs sont édifiées en basalte, avec quelques insertions de bandeaux de calcaire. Le bâtiment, qui fut dès l'origine une mosquée, est encore un lieu de culte de nos jours.

La Grande Mosquée de Diyarbakır, avec sa nef transversale et sa cour, est l’un des plus importants monuments du premier âge islamique qui ait été construit en Anatolie. Les décorations florales et géométriques qui figurent sur les portiques est et ouest de la cour autant que les décorations figuratives flanquant le portail oriental sont une preuve éclatante de l’élaboration d’une synthèse turco-islamique. Certaines décorations se trouvent sur des *spolia* romains et byzantines qui ont été réutilisés.
dates: Première moitié du Ve siècle de l’Hégire (XIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Diyarbakir ; mosquées ; décoration figurative ; spolia

tr.name: Ulu Cami.
description:
Cami, Şam'daki Emeviye Camii ile plan şeması ve kuruluşu açısından yakın benzerlikler göstermektedir. Avlusu ve bitişiğindeki medrese ile birlikte, bir kenarı yaklaşık 75 metre uzunluğunda kare bir alanı kaplamaktadır. Dörtgen avlusunun batı kenarı, daha önce buradan geçen bir sokak nedeniyle yamuktur. Cami harimi, avlunun güney kenarında yer almaktadır. Avlunun doğu ve batı kesimlerinde revaklar vardır. Kuzeyde ise dar bir geçitle birbirinden ayrılmış, Şafiler Mescidi ve Mesudiye Medresesi yer almaktadır. Harimin boyu, dıştan dışa 75 metre, eni ise 17 metredir. Minare güney duvarına bitişiktir. Kare kesitli bir kule şeklindeki minare gövdesinin üst kesimi silindirik ikinci bir gövde ve konik bir külahla son bulmaktadır.  
  
Harim, doğuda ve batıda 90 cm.x115 cm. boyutlarında dikdörtgen payelerden oluşan iki sıra destekle doğu-batı yönlü üç sahına bölünmüştür. Uzunca dikdörtgen şekilli harimin kuzey-güney ekseni üzerinde yaklaşık 11 metre genişliğinde bir çapraz sahın mevcuttur. Mihrap ve minber, çapraz sahının güney ucunda yer almaktadır. Harimin üzeri, iki yana eğimli bir çatıyla örtülüdür. Yan sahınlardan daha yüksek olan çapraz sahını ve yan sahınları örten çatının tümü dıştan kurşun levhalarla kaplanmıştır. Harimin kuzey cephesinde, bir çelenk motifi ve menderes örneklerinden oluşan süslemeler yer almaktadır. Giriş açıklıklarından birinin atkı taşının üst kısmındaki sivri kemerin iki yanında, kavsaraları istiridye kabuğu şekilli, prizmatik gömme sütunçelere sahip iki mihrabiye göze çarpmaktadır. Duvarların üst kısmına bazalttan bir saçak inşa edilmiştir.  
  
Avlunun doğu ve batısındaki revaklar iki katlıdır. Doğu revakının her iki katında da sütunlar korint düzeninde başlıklara sahiptir. üst kattaki sütunlar tek parça, alt kattaki sütunlar ise çeşitli boylarda iki veya üç sütun parçasının birleştirilmesiyle oluşturulmuştur. Batı kanadının düzeni de ana hatlarıyla doğu kanadına benzemekle birlikte, alt kat kemerlerinin dış yüzeylerinde silmeler yer almaktadır. üst kattaki sütunların tümü yekparedir ve yüzeyleri de, doğu revakından farklı olarak, değişik geometrik örneklerle süslenmiştir.  
  
Caminin doğusundaki giriş açıklığının iki köşeliğinde, simetrik olarak işlenmiş aslan-boğa mücadelesi yer almaktadır. Giriş açıklığının üst kısmındaki kitabenin ortasında, harap durumda bir aslan başı kabartması vardır ve girişi çerçeveleyen süsleme şeridi palmetlerden oluşmaktadır. Harimdeki kalemişi süslemeler 1124 / 1712 onarımında yapılmıştır.  
  
Camide, Roma/ Bizans yapılarından devşirme, bir çok yapı elemanı mevcuttur. Korint tarzı başlıklar, saçak taşları ve bazı süsleme şeritleri muhtemelen MS. IV. yüzyıla tarihlenebilecek unsurlardır. Yeniden kullanılmış antik yapı elemanları dışında caminin tümünün İslami devirde inşa edildiği kesinlikle söylenebilmekle birlikte, bütün kesimlerin tarihsel olarak tam bir uyum içinde olmadıkları görülmektedir.  
  
Duvarların dış kaplaması bazalttandır. Arada yer yer kalker şeritlere rastlanmaktadır.  
  
Cami olarak inşa edilmiş olan yapı, günümüzde de cami olarak işlevini sürdürmektedir.

Avlulu ve çapraz sahınlı şemasıyla Anadolu'da inşa edilmiş erken İslam yapılarının en önemlilerindendir. Avlu revakları üzerinde yer alan bitkisel ve geometrik süslemeler ile doğu taçkapısının iki yanındaki figürlü süslemeler, Türk-İslam sentezinin önemli verileri olarak kabul edilmektedir. Süslemelerden bazıları Roma/ Bizans dönemi yapılarından devşirmedir.
keywords: Diyarbakır; Cami; Figüratif Bezeme; Devşirme malzeme (spolie)

ar.name: إبريق
description: كانت تستخدم الأباريق مثل هذا الإبريق لصب الماء ويمكن أن توجد عادة في المنازل. ويبين الفحص أنها كانت تشكل من أربع صفائح منفصلة وكل منها تطرق وتشكّل لصنع القاعدة ، الجسم ، الكتف والعنق. وكان المقبض يصب وبعدها يوصل بالبرشمة واللحام. وفي بعض القطع مثل هذه القطعة فإن خطوط الوصل ما تزال مرئية وتظهر تقنية التداخل واللحام للوصلات.إن  القاعدة المائلة غير المزينة تؤدي إلى جسم أسطواني الذي يكون مقعرا بشكل طفيف. وأكثر سطح القطعة مزخرف بنقاط صغيرة تتوضع في صفوف أفقية. ويوجد على الكتف عصابة ذات نقش تم حفره وأيضا شريط بنموذج عظام سمكة. والعنق مزخرف بشكل أساسي بخطوط أفقية منحوتة وزخرفة مزهرة أسفل الإطار المقلوب للخارج.ويوجد طوق إضافي يصل العنق بالمقبض. وهو يتألف من سلك مبروم الذي تم تسطيحه بشكل حزام في الوسط وتم لفه حول عنق الإبريق. وهذا كان الوسيلة  لحمل واستقرار القطعة حيث أن الطريقة المذكورة أعلاه للحام العناصر تترك خط وصل الذي يكون نقاط انكسار ممكنة. وإن التخريش / التآكل الشديد الكلي يجعل من الصعب فحص الإبريق بشكل أكثر دقة. وتتضمن مجموعة هيرات أربعة أوعية من هذا النوع – وهي تظهر حتى نفس تصميم النقاط المثقبة (HNM 02.14.86, 02.25.86, 04.04.86, 02.11.86). واللقى الأخرى من مثل هذه القطع تتضمن ثلاثة أوعية من كنوز ميمانا المعدنية وثلاثة أباريق من السويد التي تحتوي أيضا كنوزا من القطع النقدية وإبريق من ميرف. بالرغم من أن هناك بعض القطع المشابهة تم الحصول عليها من مواقع الاستكشاف فإن تحديد تاريخها يبدو مسألة صعبة.لكن عن طريق القطع النقدية من المجموعة السويدية والتزيين الكلي فإنه يمكن تحديد التاريخ بأنه بين القرن التاسع والحادي عشر.

en.name: Ewer, Pitcher
description:
Ewers like this were used for pouring water and could commonly be found in the household. Examination suggests that they were formed from four separate sheets, each hammered and shaped to form the base, the body, the shoulder and the neck. The handle was cast and then attached by riveting and soldering. On some objects of this type, the seams are still visible, showing the technique of interlocking and soldering the joints.  
The slanting, undecorated base leads into a cylindrical body which is slightly concave. Most of its surface is adorned with small dots in horizontal rows. On the shoulder a band with an inscription was engraved, as well as a ribbon in a fish-bone pattern. The neck is mainly ornamented by carved horizontal lines and one floral ornament below the slightly everted rim. An extra bracing connects the neck to the handle. It consists of a twisted wire that was flattened to a belt in the middle and wrapped around the neck of the ewer. This was to support and stabilise the object, as the above mentioned way of fusing its components leaves the seams as potential breaking points. The overall heavy corrosion makes it difficult to examine the ewer more closely.  
The Herat collection hosts four vessels of this type – they even show the same design of punched dots (HNM 02.14.86, 02.25.86, 04.04.86, 02.11.86). Other finds of this type of artefact include three vessels from the Maymana metal-hoard, three ewers from Sweden, which even contained coin hoards, and one copper ewer from Merv.  
Even though there are some comparable pieces from excavated contexts, the dating still seems to be a difficult issue. Through the coins from the Swedish examples, however, and the overall decoration a date range between the 9th and 11th century is suggested.
holder: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection
keywords: Ewer; pitcher; punched; hammered
materials: Hammered from sheet metal, cast, fused, punched, engraved
tags: Hammered from sheet metal, cast, fused, punched, engraved

en.name: Coffee pot
short_description: Coffee formed the basis of all hospitality rituals in the Arabian Peninsula. The coffee beans were freshly roasted, ground and brewed in coffee pots whenever guests were received, and a strict etiquette was followed in the serving of coffee, with offence easily taken if any breach of the expected procedure occurred. Hospitality was a source of tremendous pride and no respectable host would be seen without a variety of coffee pots with which to honour his guests. In the Arabian peninsula, coffee pots were originally made of earthenware, but were replaced by more durable and ostentatious copper coffee pots.
keywords: coffee

en.name: Ottoman Clothing Album
short_description: With the political developments of the 19th century, interest in the East increased steadily in the western world. Everything belonging to the East was the centre of interest for western observers. As a result, close to 160 artists visited Istanbul in the 19th century. Pascal Sébah (1823-86) was a pioneer photographer who worked in Istanbul. Sébah opened a photography studio known as "El Chark " in Pera in 1857. The studio's most successful period started with the Vienna Universal Exhibition in 1873. Sébah formed a partnership with Joaillier Polycarpe in 1885. In 1899, the two partners bought Abdullah Frères's archives. For the Vienna Universal Exhibition in 1873, Pascal Sébah prepared *The Ottoman Clothing Album* to be exhibited at the Ottoman Stand.

en.name: La Lugareja
description:
La Lugareja, also called the Church of Gómez Román, conserves a sanctuary with three apses, the transept and two side-bays. The building is brick with broad joints and squint brick in the windows of the apses; the apses are covered with pointed oven vaulting and are separated by arches on cavettos. Above the transept, there is a lantern with a cupola resting on blind arcades and four squinches. The interior is decorated with multiple stone heads and floral motifs. The exterior has a square tower with arcades.  
In 1257, the brothers Gómez Román founded a convent here for nuns and gave their name to the church. The foundations of the nave still exist, but the church must have been unfinished and closed off at the level of the transept. The reason for this was probably that it was considered too far away from the village, so the nuns were transferred to Arévalo and the convent became simply a shrine.

es.name: La Lugareja
description:
La Lugareja, llamada también Iglesia de Gómez Román, conserva una cabecera de tres ábsides, el crucero y dos tramos laterales. La fábrica es de ladrillo con grandes tendeles y ladrillo moldurado en las ventanas de los ábsides. Los ábsides cierran con bóvedas de horno apuntadas, separadas por arcos sobre nacelas. Sobre el crucero se levanta una linterna con cúpula apuntada sobre arquerías ciegas y cuatro pechinas. En el interior está decorada con múltiples cabezas de cantería y temas florales. En el exterior hay una torre cuadrada con arcadas.  
En 1257, los hermanos Gómez Román fundaron aquí un monasterio para monjas y dieron su nombre al templo. Los basamentos de las naves aún existen, pero el templo debió quedar inconcluso, cerrándose a la altura del crucero. Posiblemente fue la lejanía en que quedaba el pueblo lo que aconsejó trasladar a las monjas a Arévalo y convertir el monasterio en una simple ermita.

en.name: Rua das Amoreiras Arch
description: Thanks to the architectural risk-taking of Carlos Mardel, the Rua das Amoreiras arch was built between 1746 and 1748. Two things make this monumental structure particularly notable: its innovation, for over the final perpendicular branch of the aqueduct the water galleries from Alcântara run and this had never before been seen; and the engineering – from here the aqueduct turns sharp right to the Mãe d'Água reservoir. The Amoreiras Arch frames the Rua das Amoreiras and represented at one time an “entrance”, as if it were an arch in a defensive wall, highlighting both the exceptional status of this hydraulic masterpiece and its setting.
partner: Institute for the Administration of Architectural and Archaeological Heritage -  IGESPAR

pt.name: Arco da Rua das Amoreiras
description: Devido ao risco do Carlos Mardel, o Arco da rua das Amoreiras foi construído de l746 a l748. Trata-se do uma obra monumental, perpendicular ao troço final do aqueduto e sobre o qual – numa combinação inédita – correm as galerias de águas que provêm de Alcântara, antes da angulação em direcção à Mãe d’Água. Enquadra a rua das Amoreiras e constituía uma “entrada”, como se de um arco de muralha se tratasse, realçando o estatuto excepcional desta obra hidráulica.

en.name: Long-necked amphora
description:
This long-necked terracotta amphora from 19th-century Algeria is a prime example of impressive Kabyle pottery. These large terracotta amphorae are distinguished by their elongated necks, multilinear decorations, and distinctive horned handles.  
Even today, Kabyle women continue the tradition of coil-building and mould pattern techniques, decorating pottery with intricate geometric designs for household use.  
Skilled artisans create vessels of diverse sizes and shapes for storing water, milk, and oil, and for cooking and dining. The amphora’s decorative motifs, in black and brick red on a yellow slip, under a glaze, bear profound symbolic significance within Amazigh culture. These patterns, deeply ingrained in the Kabyle tradition, include a distinctive U-shaped design at the centre of the vessel that corresponds to the letter "ⵓ" in the Amazigh language, pronounced "oo" as in "moo". This symbolises either the moon, representing female fertility, or a horseshoe, symbolising fidelity. The firing process not only ensures the vessel’s durability, but also enhances the vibrant colours of the glazes, showcasing the exceptional skill and craftsmanship of Kabyle artisans. These artefacts speak to the cultural heritage and linguistic richness of the Amazigh people.

cs.name: *Hostina sv. Antonína Paduánského*
description:
Téma obrazu je poměrně málo zobrazovaným výjevem ze života sv. Antonína Padovánského, kněze, kazatele a následovníka sv. Františka z Assisi. Tento františkánský světec sedí u prostřeného stolu v domě boháče a žehná pohárům vína. Zleva přináší putto lilii, symbol čistoty a jeden z atributů světce. Vpravo jsou na odiv vystaveny drahocenné kusy nádobí, jak tomu bylo při hostinách od 16. století zvykem. Přes centrální nasvícení scény jsou v obraze patrné dvě významové části. Levá značí střídmost a pokoru, pravá přepych a nadřazenost. Tento obsah vyjadřuje malíř také figurálními typy. Tvář sv. Antonína obklopená svatozáří vyjadřuje duchovní prožitek, zatímco v obhroublém obličeji boháče se zračí smyslový požitek, nenasytnost a přízemní chápání celé situace. Na jeho obžerství, jeden ze smrtelných hříchů, poukazuje naslouchající muž vpravo, sledován malým pážetem. Scénu malíř zdůraznil repusoárovým motivem purpurové draperie, udávající barevný tón celému obrazu. Malba se svým šerosvitným pojetím a komorním, až žánrovým charakterem vyděluje z běžně známé Krackerovy tvorby oltářních pláten a nástropních fresek. V malbě je také výrazně patrný malířův smělý rukopis,  
v rozměrných malbách zanikající.  
Spolu s Hostinou sv. Rodiny a Hostinou sv. Václava tvořil obraz výzdobu refektáře františkánského kostela v Moravské Třebové.  
Kracker patří mezi přední představitele stylu vídeňské akademie, reprezentovaným Paulem Trogerem a Michelangelem Unterbergerem. Po studiu ve Vídni Kracker pracoval v brněnské dílně Josefa Tadeáše Rottera, poté se usadil ve Znojmě. Mezi jeho nejznámější malby patří nástropní malba a oltářní obrazy v kostele sv. Mikuláše v Praze-Malé Straně a v Nové Říši. Pozdní dílo vytvořil v Uhrách, kde vstoupil do služeb jagerského biskupa K. Esterházyho.

Téma obrazu je poměrně málo zobrazovaným výjevem ze života sv. Antonína Paduánského, kněze, kazatele a následovníka sv. Františka z Assisi. Plátno je částí cyklu z výzdoby refektáře františkánského kostela v Moravské Třebové a patří mezi raná díla malíře, činného v Čechách, na Moravě a v Uhrách.

en.name: *Feast of St. Anthony of Padua*
description:
The subject is a relatively scarcely represented scene from the life of St. Anthony of Padua, priest, preacher and disciple of St. Francis of Assisi. The Franciscan saint sits at the table in the house of a wealthy man, blessing goblets of wine. On the left, a *putto* brings a lily, symbol of purity and one of the saint's attributes. On the right, precious tableware is displayed, as was customary at feasts from the 16th century onwards. Although the scene is illuminated at the centre, the picture features two pictorial sections: the left symbolising austerity and humbleness and the right, luxury and superiority. The artist also draws attention to the two sections by use of character types: the face of St. Anthony with his halo reflecting spiritual delight, while the gross face of the rich man shows sensual pleasure, greed and a boorish approach to the situation. The listening man on the right points out his gluttony, one of the seven deadly sins. The painter highlights the scene with a contrasting motif of deep-red drapery, which sets the colour tone for the whole picture. The painting stands out among Kracker's altarpieces and ceiling frescos because of its genre-painting atmosphere and use of chiaroscuro. It also manifests the artist's bold monogram *JK*, but not as distinctively as on some of his more sizeable compositions.  
The picture was part of the decoration of the refectory in the Franciscan Monastery in Moravská Třebová, together with *The Feast of the Holy Family* and *The Feast of St. Wenceslas*.  
Kracker was a leading exponent of the Vienna Academy style represented by Paul Troger and Michelangelo Unterberger. After studying in Vienna Kracker was active in the workshop of Josef Tadeáš Rotter in Brno, and later settled in Znojmo. His best-known works include ceiling paintings and altarpieces in the Church of St. Nicholas in Prague and in Nová Říše. His later work was associated with Hungary, where he joined the service of Bishop K. Esterházy in Jager.

The subject is a relatively scarcely represented scene from the life of St. Anthony of Padua. The canvas formed part of the decoration in the refectory of the Franciscan Monastery in Moravská Třebová. It is an early piece by the artist, J. L. Kracker who was active in Bohemia, Moravia and Hungary.

en.name: Norman Castle
description:
The castle is situated above the highest rock of Mount San Giuliano, where the temple dedicated to the goddess of fertility once stood. The castle was founded in about the 8th century BC, and dominates the plain below providing an obvious reference for whomsoever arrives by sea. With the arrival of the Phoenicians in Sicily, the temple became the centre of public life, whether religious, in honour of the Goddess Astarte, or military, because of its domination of the plain and its maritime control. While under the Romans the sanctuary acquired prestige as the centre of the official religion, experiencing its maximum splendour. Further, the Roman Senate had delegated 17 Sicilian cities to maintain at their own expense, both the restored sanctuary and the garrisoning of 200 militia guards to defend it. The incision on the front of the coinage of C. Considio Noniano is the only testimony bearing witness to the ancient temple of Venere Ericina, protector of sailors.With the fall of the Roman Empire the strategic value of the place was ended, in favour of the commercial centre below of *Drepanon* (Trapani). After about 800 years of silence, with the arrival of the Normans and thanks to Ruggero II, Erice revived with the result that, according to Ibn Jubayr, by 1185 a castle was built on the ruins of the Temple of Venus. A fortified outpost was also built with three towers, two on a rectangular plan and a central one, pentagonal, called the Towers of the Bailiff (Balio), because they were destined for the residence of the Norman Governor (the *bajulo*).The towers, designed as defence emplacements, were linked together by a walled curtain and drawbridge leading to the Castle of Venus. In the  
15th century the pentagonal tower was destroyed, and later, in 1873, rebuilt during restoration works and the making of the adjacent gardens, laid out in terraces, as requested by the Trapanese Baron, Agostino Pepoli.The castle is reached by way of a ramp built in the 17th century by the castellan Antonio Palma, and, therefore, also the ancient *temenos* of the sanctuary of Venus, protected by a protruding tower on the right, emerging as the backdrop to the presentday Via Conte Pepoli. The main front of the castle is characterised by the ogival entrance, above which is to be found the coat of arms of the house of Hapsburg of Spain, and crowned with large blackbirds with swallow tails. The planimetric development around the courtyard is more or less quadrangular, although the walls in several places follow the uneven outline of the rock, adapting to it for the defence of the downward slopes.Three sides of the castle are in fact inaccessible because they are erected on overhanging ridges of rock. All the work of the castle walls is executed in *opus incertum*, with the exception of the corners that are in freestone; but in a short stretch of one of the sides of the overhang, Greek walling, with enormous parallelepiped ashlars in dry stone, can be identified.  
The central court is reached by way of steps from a first structure covered with pointed vaults. The Pozzo di Venere (Well of Venus) is located inside the courtyard, cylindrical in shape and excavated from the rock. It is so-called because it was kept for use as a bath for the ablutions of the priestesses of the goddess, later probably used instead to keep the wheat in for the soldiers guarding the temple. Many of the peripheral buildings of the castle were used at the time of the Normans as prisons, which held some famous persons such as the Count of San Severino in 1299, one of the leaders of the Angevin army captured in the Battle of Falconeria. Some fragments of columns round a rectangular base have been found in the courtyard.  
These finds make it possible to place the  
*temenos* of the Temple of Erice, as well as the remains of the wall sustaining the socalled Bridge of Daedalus, drums of Ionic columns, fragments of friezes and decorative elements of the Doric order.

es.name: Castillo Normando
description:
El Castillo, situado sobre la peña más alta del monte San Giuliano, donde en otro tiempo se alzaba el templo dedicado a la diosa de la fecundidad fundado hacia el siglo VIII a. C., domina la llanura a sus pies y constituye una referencia evidente para quien viene por mar. Con la llegada de los fenicios a Sicilia, el templo se convirtió en un centro tanto religioso, en honor de la diosa Astarté, como militar, para el dominio de la llanura y la vigilancia del mar, mientras que bajo los romanos el santuario adquirió el prestigio de centro de culto estatal y conoció su máximo esplendor. El senado romano, además, había delegado en 17 ciudades sicilianas el mantenimiento a su costa tanto del restaurado santuario como de la guarnición de 200 mílites destinada a su custodia. La incisión en el anverso de la moneda de C. Considio Noniano es el único documento que da fe del aspecto del antiguo templo de Venus Ericina, protectora de los navegantes. Con la caída del imperio romano cesó la importancia estratégica del lugar en favor del enclave comercial de la llanura Drepanon (Trapani); después de casi ochocientos años de silencio, con los normandos y gracias a Ruggero II, Erice volvió a la vida; así, y según el testimonio de Ibn Yubayr, en 1185 se había reconstruido ya un castillo sobre los restos del templo de Venus. Se edificó, además, un puesto avanzado fortificado, provisto de tres torres, dos de planta rectangular y una, en el centro, pentagonal, llamadas Torres del Balio por estar destinadas a la residencia del gobernador normando (el “baiulo”). Las torres, configuradas como puesto de defensa, estaban comunicadas entre sí por una cortina de muralla y con el castillo de Venus por un puente levadizo. En el siglo XV, sin embargo, la torre pentagonal se destruyó, para ser reconstruida en 1873 durante los trabajos de restauración y la realización de los jardines adyacentes, dispuestos en terraza, por deseo de Agostino Pepoli, Barón de Trapani. Al Castillo, y por consiguiente al antiguo temenos del santuario de Venus, protegido por una torre avanzada a su derecha que sobresale al fondo de la actual Via Conte Pepoli, se llega por una escalinata construida en el siglo XVII por el castellano Antonio Palma. El frente principal de la fortaleza se caracteriza por la puerta ojival de entrada, con el emblema de la casa Habsburgo de España encima y coronada por poderosas almenas en cola de golondrina. La planta, que se organiza alrededor de un patio, es casi cuadrangular, si bien las estructuras murales siguen en varios puntos el perfil accidentado de la roca, adaptándose a ella para la defensa de los declives. Tres de los flancos del Castillo, en efecto, resultan inaccesibles al estar levantados sobre crestas rocosas en picado. Toda la obra mural del Castillo está hecha en *opus incertum*, a excepción de los cantones de piedra cortada; pero en un corto tramo de uno de los lados sobre el precipicio se distingue el muro griego, de enormes sillares paralelepípedos de piedra sin argamasa.  
Desde un primer volumen cubierto con bóveda de perfil apuntado, se accede, por un tramo de escalera, al patio central; en su interior está el Pozo de Venus, de forma cilíndrica, excavado en la roca y llamado así porque se cree que se usaba como pileta para las abluciones de las sacerdotisas de la diosa, aunque es más probable que almacenara el trigo para los soldados que guardaban el templo. Muchos de los edificios periféricos del Castillo se utilizaron en la época normanda como cárceles que acogieron a hombres ilustres, como en 1299 al Conde de San Severino, uno de los jefes del ejército angevino capturado en la batalla de Falconeria. En el patio se han hallado fragmentos de columnas en torno a un basamento rectangular, que permiten circunscribir el *temenos* del templo ericino, además de restos del muro de contención del llamado Puente de Dédalo, trozos de columnas jónicas, fragmentos de friso y elementos decorativos de orden dórico.

en.name: Hijaz Railway Medal
description: Medal of the Hijaz Railway fund. In September 1900, (the 25th anniversary of Sultan Abdul Hamid’s accession to throne) he addressed a call for all the Muslims all over the world to collect donations for establishing a railway between Damascus and the holy places to facilitate transporting the pilgrims. The call was responded to enthusiastically and with great support from all Muslims. Sultan Abdul Hamid II began the donations with 300,000 Ottoman gold lira, then kings and heads of Islamic world donated money or materials for setting the railway. The donations continued till 1907. On this occasion the sultan issued gold, silver and nickel medals to donors – for instance a nickel medal given to whoever donated 5-50 Lira, a silver medal for whoever donated 50-100 Lira and named them bey, and for donations of more than 100 Lira a gold medal and the title of Pasha. After that the donation become compulsory in which the officials disclaim a one month salary. This is a gilt nickel medal issued AH 1318 / AD 1900. On its obverse, within a wreath: tuğra of sultan Abdul Hamid II with "al-Ghazi" and form of locomotive and the date ١٣١۸ (AH 1318) below. On reverse, حميديه حجاز تيمور يولنه خدمت ايدن حميتمندانه مخصوص مدالية در ("Medal reserved to patriots who have served the Hamidiye Hijaz Railway") written in Divan script.
keywords: Railway; pilgrimage; 'Abd al-Hamid; Ottoman; Germany; Hijaz; Makka al-Mukarrama; Mecca; al-Madina al-Munawwara; Medina; sharif; railway; route; numismatics

en.name: Hama Archaeological Museum
description:
**Noria Mosaic**: This is the first visual record of the magnificent hydraulic waterwheel-structure known as *noria*. The Byzantine mosaic panel, originally located in Apamea, has a date AD 469. It measures 148 cm x 170 cm and is irregular in shape due to loss of material. Despite its fragmentary state, the different elements that make up the *noria* are evident, such as the wooden beams and circular frame of the wheel, the streams of water that pour from the buckets as it rotates, and the triangular structure made of stone blocks that supports the *noria*’s axle. Various colours feature in the *tesserae* of the mosaic: grey, brown, beige, yellowish beige and pinkish beige – to distinguish the different media of the noria.  
**Shaduf Jar**: Like the *noria*, the *shaduf*, is another method of water-collecting technology, which is similarly ancient. The *shaduf* is a more provincial construct, and the wheel is generally smaller in size The *shaduf*, unlike the *noria*, is not propelled by the momentum of the river, but is instead driven by animal power; a mule, for example, would walk in circles to rotate the wheel. Attached to the mechanism by way of a rope around the neck or through a pierced hole, these distinctively shaped jars held the water collected by the *shaduf*. The exact date and place of production of *shaduf* jars is unknown, but they are indigenous to the Hama region, and probably date back to some time between the 6th/12th and 8th/14th centuries. Indeed, to this day there is a village called “Tel Shaduf ”, located to the north of the Salamiyya and Shmemis citadels. On average, the dimensions of these *shaduf* jars are 28.5 cm high, 7.5 cm wide at the base, and 11.5 cm wide at the rim.  
**Minbar of Nur al-Din**: This *minbar* was originally part of the new Mosque of Nur al-Din in Hama, its beauty matched only by its strong political message relating to Islamic piety and Holy War. Standing tall and copiously carved, it is made of wood, 84 cm wide, 318 cm long and 425 cm at its utmost height; the crescent-shaped finial above the domed seat. Geometric designs and calligraphic inscriptions executed in *naskhi* script indicate the name and titlature of the patron, Nur al-Din, and the date of its execution, 559/1263–4. The top of the seat back is decorated with an arched frame with carved-interlacing hexagonal patterns, amidst which is the testimony of faith “*La Ilaha Illa Alla*” (“There is no god but God”), and “*Muhammad Rasul Allah*” (“Muhammad is God’s Prophet”), carved in two cartouches and executed in broad calligraphy set on a delicate background of spiralling tendrils. The lower part of the seat back is composed of a hexagonal and triangular grid with pierced brackets that highlight the pattern and make the structure itself less heavy. A magnificent cornice, with floral carving and sculptural floral crenellations along the rim, gives the *minbar* a throne-like quality accentuated by the dome and its farreaching crescent finial.  
The banisters currently on the *minbar* are modern restorations, but one of the original banisters hangs on the wall to the right of the minbar and presents the original features of Nur al-Din’s inscription, executed in *naskhi* script, all along the frame. The body of the banister, carved with a matrix of criss-crossing lines with diamond-shaped piercing at the intersections, has a zigzag design along the periphery.

ar.name: علبة قاجارية مدهونة باللكر
description: علبة المجوهرات المطلية باللكر هذه تصور الحاكم الثاني للأسرة القاجارية في القرن التاسع عشر فتح علي شاه . ويظهر وهو جالس على عرش بشكل طاووس مغولي مهيب وقد أحاط به ثلاثة من أولاده ووزارئه وأشخاص مهمين آخرين. واللوحات الجانبية المزينة برصائع نافرة على خلفية مكونة من وردة وطائر البلبل وتظهر أشخاص من البلاط بلباس غربي ومشاهد طبيعية ومشاهد صيد. وعلب المجوهرات المذكورة في كتاب ويليام اوسلي (أسفار في بلدان عديدة من الشرق ،بشكل أخص بلاد فارس) (1823) تستند لزياراته إلى إيران. ويقول أوسلي بأن علب المجوهرات هذه – المصنوعة من الورق وصمغ السيريش كانت تنتج بكميات كبيرة في أصفهان وهناك الآن عدد من القطع المشابهة في متاحف ومجموعات عديدة . وقد ذكر أيضا العلب المطلية بالورنيش / البرنيق المشابهة لعلب فتح علي شاه. والأشياء الشائعة المتضمنة في هذه الرسوم هي مشاهد المعارك وحفلات الصيد وأيضا صور لمشاهد رومانسية معروفة.
dates: القرن الثالث الهجري / القرن التاسع الميلادي
keywords: لكر

en.name: Qajar lacquer Casket
description: This lacquer casket depicts the second ruler of the 19th-century Qajar dynasty, Fath’Ali Shah. Seated on the legendary Mughal Peacock Throne, he is flanked by three of his sons, ministers, and other important figures. The side panels, decorated with raised medallions on a *gul-ol-bulbul* (rose and bulbul bird) background, show courtiers in Western clothing, landscapes, and hunting scenes. The caskets are mentioned in William Ouseley’s *Travels into Various Countries of the East; More Particularly Persia* (1823), based on his visits to Iran. Ouseley claims these caskets—made of paper and a serish glue—were mass produced in Isfahan; there are now a number of similar objects in various museums and collections. He also mentions beautifully painted, varnished boxes similar to the Fath’Ali Shah caskets. Common subjects included battle scenes and hunting parties as well as depictions of popular romances.
keywords: lacquer

ar.name: طغراء السلطان عثمان الثالث.
description:
رسمت الأحرف الأولى لاسم السلطان أو طغرائه بالذهب، محاطة بكفاف من الحبر الأسود على أرضية زرقاء. أما المساحات ما بين الأحرف في القسم السفلي من الطغراء، وأذرعها، والقوس المشع، فمكسوة بزخرفة زهرية. وهذه التشكيلات الزهرية تظهر أسلوبين مختلفين: أحدهما يحاكي الفن الصيني، والآخر يعكس تأثير تصاميم الباروك الأوروبية في الزخرفة العثمانية. ففي الزاوية العلوية اليمنى نرى صورة للكعبة في مكة وأخرى للمدينة منفذتين في إطار بيضوي الشكل. ويمكن رؤية تشكيلات مماثلة لهاتين اللوحتين في الفنون الزخرفية ورسوم المخطوطات والقرميد في القرن 11- 12 / 17 – 18. ويوجد في الزاوية السفلية اليسرى رصيعة تحتوي على توقيع الفنان الذي أنجز الطغراء، قراباغلي سليمان باشا، بعبارة تقول: 'خادم البلاط، سليمان باشا، صنع طغراء سلطان العالم'، مرفق بتاريخ 1270 (1854). وهذا التاريخ مفاجئ وربما غير صحيح نظراً لأن الأميرال سليمان باشا لا يظهر اسمه في المصادر التاريخية لهذا العام. كما أنه رقي لهذه المرتبة على يد السلطان عثمان الثالث عام 1168 / 1754، وبقي في منصبه حتى أزيح عام 1171 / 1757. وفي العام نفسه أعيد إلى مركزه على يد السلطان مصطفى الثالث ( حكم في الفترة 1171- 1187 / 1757- 1774)، وبقي في منصبه حتى عام 1172 / 1759. ولأن العمل خضع لترميمات عديدة في فترات مختلفة، فمن المؤكد أن تاريخه يعود للعام 1170 / 1756- 1757، وليس للعام 1270 / 1853- 1854. إن السلطان عثمان الثالث، الذي اعتلى العرش في الخامسة والخمسين من عمره، كان الأمير العثماني الأكبر سناً في تولي السلطنة، وامتدت فترة حكمه لثلاث سنوات فقط. ونقرأ على الطغراء 'عثمان خان بن مصطفى، الغالب دوماً'.  
  
الطغراء عبارة عن توقيع للسلاطين العثمانيين، يصدره موظف رسمي من الديوان الإمبراطوري، أو يشرف عليه. وبسبب حجمه، وحقيقة كونه مصمماً كي يظهر بالتفصيل ملامح الطغراء كلها، فلا بد أنه صنع في الديوان الإمبراطوري بوصفه نموذجاً يهدف إلى التأكد من أن النسخات المأخوذة عنه خالية من أية أخطاء.

تبقى أختام الطغراء، التي هي التواقيع الرسمية للسلاطين، إحدى أولى الحاجات التي تخطر بالبال، لدى ذكر الفن، أو التاريخ العثمانيين. وحجم هذه الطغراء العائدة للسلطان عثمان الثالث، يجعلها أنموذجاً لافتاً، وهي متمتعة بسمات تخصّ فنّ القرن الثاني عشر الهجري/ الثامن عشر الميلادي.
artist: الأميرال الأكبر قراباغلي سليمان باشا، فنان طغراء القصر (فترة الخدمة: 1168- 1171 / 1754- 1757).
keywords: تلوين مائي؛ توشية بالذهب؛ خشب؛ رسم؛ طغراء.

en.name: *Tuğra* of Sultan Osman III.
description:
The Sultan's official monogram or *tuğra* (tughra) is drawn in gold outlined with black ink on a blue ground. The areas between the letters in the lower part of the *tuğra*, the 'arms' of the *tuğra*, and its flaring bow are filled with floral decoration. These floral compositions show two different styles: one following the Chinese influence *hatayi*\-style, and the other reflecting the appearance of baroque designs in Ottoman illumination under European influence. In the upper right-hand corner are depictions of the Ka'ba in Mecca and of Medina rendered in an oval frame. The paintings of Mecca and Medina resemble similar compositions in AH 11th–12th- / AD 17th–18th- century decorative arts, manuscript painting and tiles. In the lower left-hand corner is a medallion containing the signature of the artist who drew the *tuğra*, Karabağlı Kaptan-ı Derya Süleyman Pasha, phrased thus: 'The slave of the court, Süleyman Pasha, made the *tuğra* of the Sultan of the world'. The date AH 1270 (AD 1854) is also given. This is surprising and possibly incorrect for Kaptan-ı Derya (Grand Admiral) Süleyman Pasha does not appear in the historical sources for that year. He was promoted to that rank by Sultan Osman III in AH 1168 / AD 1754 and remained in that position until he was removed from it in AH 1171 / AD 1757. In the same year he was restored to his post by Sultan Mustafa III (r. AH 1171–87 / AD 1757–74) and remained in it until AH 1172 / AD 1759. Since the work has undergone much restoration in various periods, the date must be AH 1170 / AD 1756–7 rather than AH 1270 / 1853–4.  
  
Sultan Osman III, who ascended the throne at age fifty-five, was the oldest Ottoman prince to become sultan, and his reign lasted only three years. The *tuğra* reads 'Osman Khan, son of Mustafa, ever-victorious'. The *tuğra* was a kind of signature of the Ottoman sultans, drawn by a special official of the Imperial Chancery (*Divan-ı Hümayun*) or under his instruction. Because of its size and the fact that it is executed so as to display in detail all the aspects of a *tuğra*, this example must have been made in the Imperial Chancery as a model with the aim of ensuring that *tuğra* copies could be made without any mistakes.

*Tughras*, official monograms of the sultans, are one the first things to come to mind when Ottoman art or history is mentioned. The size of this *tughra* of Sultan Osman III makes it an interesting example and it has features peculiar to the art of the AH 12th / AD 18th century.
holder: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts.
artist: Kaptan-ı Derya (Grand Admiral) Karabağlı Süleyman Pasha, court tuğra artist (dates of service: AH 1168–71 / AD 1754–57).
keywords: Wood; gilding; watercolour; painting; tuğra; tughra
tags: Kaptan-ı Derya (Grand Admiral) Karabağlı Süleyman Pasha
partner: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts

es.name: *Tugra* del sultán Otman III.
description:
Esta *tuğra* o monograma oficial del sultán es de color dorado y está perfilado con tinta negra sobre fondo azul. Las zonas que quedan entre las letras, los "brazos" de la *tugra* y su llamativo lazo están decoradas con adornos florales que muestran dos estilos diferentes: uno refleja la influencia del estilo *hatayi* de China y el otro, la de los diseños barrocos de la ilustración otomana de inspiración europea. En el ángulo superior derecho se ve un marco ovalado que contiene imágenes de la Kaaba y de Medina que recuerdan a otras composiciones presentes en las artes decorativas, las ilustraciones de manuscritos y los azulejos de los siglos XI-XII / XVII-XVII. En el ángulo inferior izquierdo hay un medallón con la firma del autor, Karabağlı Kaptan-ı Derya Süleyman Paşa, que se expresa así: "El esclavo de la corte, Süleyman Paşa, creó la tugra del sultán del mundo". También consta una fecha (1270 / 1854) que posiblemente sea errónea, puesto que Kaptan-ı Derya (gran almirante) Süleyman Paşa no aparece en las fuentes históricas de ese año. El sultán Otman III lo ascendió a gran almirante en 1168 / 1754 y permaneció en el cargo hasta que fue destituido, en 1171 / 1757. Ese mismo año, el sultán Mustafa III (r. 1171-1187 / 1757-1774) lo restituyó en el cargo y en él permaneció hasta 1171 / 1759. Dado que la obra se ha restaurado en numerosas ocasiones en diversos periodos, la fecha debe ser 1170 / 1756-1757 y no 1270 / 1853-1854.  
El sultán Otman III, que ascendió al trono a los cincuenta y cinco años, fue el príncipe otomano que llegó a sultán con más edad y su sultanato duró sólo tres años. La *tugra* reza: "Osman Jan, hijo de Mustafa, siempre victorioso".  
La *tugra* era una especie de firma de los sultanes otomanos, dibujada por un oficial especial de la cancillería imperial (Divan-ı Hümayun) o bajo sus órdenes. Esta pieza, a juzgar por su tamaño y el nivel de detalle en todos sus aspectos, debió de elaborarse en la cancillería imperial como modelo para garantizar que todas las copias se realizasen sin errores.

Los monogramas oficiales de los sultanes son uno de los elementos más característicos del arte y la historia otomanos. Esta *tugra* del sultán Otman III, que presenta rasgos propios del arte del siglo XII / XVIII, es especialmente interesante por su tamaño.
holder: Museo de Arte Turco e Islámico.
artist: Kaptan-ı Derya (gran almirante) Karabağlı Süleyman Paşa, creador de *tugra* de la corte (activo en 1168-1171 / 1754-1757).
keywords: Madera; dorado; acuarela; pintura; tuğra.
partner: Museo de Artes Turcas e Islámicas

fr.name: Tughra du sultan Osman (Uthman) III.
description:
*Tughra* dessiné en noir sur fond bleu. Les zones entre les lettres de la partie inférieure, les “bras” du *tughra*, et sa boucle enflée sont remplis d'un décor floral. Ce type de composition annonce l'apparition du dessin baroque dans l'enluminure ottomane sous influence européenne. Dans l'angle supérieur droit figurent des représentations de la Kaaba à La Mecque, et de Médine. Ces illustrations peintes ressemblent à des compositions similaires du XIe-XIIe siècle H (XVIIe-XVIIIe siècle J.-C.) observées dans les arts décoratifs, la peinture de manuscrit et la céramique. Dans l'angle inférieur gauche, un médaillon contient la signature de l'artiste auteur du *tughra* ; Karaba-li Kaptan-i Derya Soliman Pacha présenté ainsi : “L'esclave de la cour, Soliman Pacha, a réalisé le *tughra* du sultan du monde.” La date, 1270 H / 1854 J.-C., est également mentionnée, bien que le Kaptan-i Derya (grand amiral) Soliman Pacha ne figure pas dans les sources historiques de cette même année. Il fut promu à ce rang par le sultan Osman III en 1168 H / 1754 J.-C., position qu'il conserva jusqu'en 1171 H / 1757 J.-C. avant d'être destitué. La même année, le sultan Moustafa III (r. 1171-1187 H / 1757-1774) le rétablit dans sa fonction, qu'il conserva jusqu'en 1172 H / 1759 J.-C. Comme cette œuvre a été restaurée à diverses périodes, on peut penser que la date est 1170 H / 1757 J.-C. plutôt que 1270 H / 1854 J.-C.  
Le sultan Osman II, qui monta sur le trône à l'âge de 55 ans, fut le plus âgé des princes ottomans à devenir sultan et son règne ne dura que trois ans. Le *tughra* indique : “Osman Khan, fils de Moustafa, le toujours victorieux.” Les *tughra* constituaient une sorte de signature des sultans ottomans et étaient dessinées par un fonctionnaire spécialisé de la chancellerie impériale (*Divan-i Hümayun*) sous les instructions de celle-ci. Ses dimensions et le fait qu'il ait été exécuté de façon à montrer en détail tous les aspects du *tughra* font penser que cet exemple a été réalisé pour servir de modèle au *tughra* du souverain.

Les *tughra*, les monogrammes officiels des sultans, sont les premiers éléments qui viennent à l’esprit lorsque l’histoire ou l’art ottoman sont mentionnés. La taille de ce *tughra* du sultan Osman III en fait un exemple intéressant ; il a également des caractéristiques particulières à l’art du XIIe siècle H (XVIIIe siècle J.-C.).
holder: Musée des arts turcs et islamiques.
artist: Kaptan-i Derya Karabaşli Soliman Pacha, artiste de la cour, en fonction de 1168 à 1171 H / 1754-1757 J.-C.
keywords: bois ; dorure ; aquarelle ; peinture
partner: Musée des arts turques et islamiques

tr.name: Sultan III. Osman’ın Tuğrası.
description:
Tuğra, mavi zemin üzerine siyah konturlu altın yaldızla çekilmiştir. Tuğranın seresindeki harflerin arası, tuğra kolları, iç ve dış beyze bitkisel kompozisyonlarla süslenmiştir. Bitkisel kompozisyonlar; hatayi kompozisyonlar ile Avrupa etkisiyle Osmanlı tezhibine giren barok çiçek desenleri olmak üzere iki farklı üsluptadır. Sağ üst köşede oval bir çerve içine yerleştirilmiş iki yuvarlak madalyonda Mekke (Kabe) ve Medine'nin resimleri yer almaktadır. Mekke ve Medine'nin resimleri, 11.-12. / 17.-18. yüzyıl süsleme sanatında el yazmalarında ve levhalarda olduğu gibi çinilerde de görülen bir kompozisyondur. Sol alt köşede ise dilimli bir madalyon içinde, tuğrayı çeken Karabağlı Kaptan-ı Derya Süleyman Paşa “Kıldı tuğrasını Sultan-ı cihanın imla bende-i hass-ı kapudan Süleyman Paşa” şeklinde adı ve H. 1270 tarihini yazdığı ketebe bulunmaktadır. Ancak H. 1270 yılında Kaptan-ı Derya Süleyman Paşa adına tarihi kaynaklarda raslanmamıştır. Süleyman Paşa 1754 yılında Sultan III. Osman tarafından Kaptan-ı Deryalığa getirilmiş ve bu görevi 1757 yılına kadar sürdürmüştür. 1757 yılında önce görevden alınmış, Sultan III. Mustafa (H.1171-1187/ M. 1757-1774) döneminde aynı yıl görevine iade edilmiş ve 1759 yılına kadar bu görevi sürdürmüştür. Levhanın çeşitli dönemlerde pek çok restorasyon geçirdiği de dikkate alındığında tarihin H. 1270 değil H. 1170 olması gerekmektedir.  
  
Ellibeş yaşında tahta çıkan Sultan III. Osman, tahta çıkan en yaşlı Osmanlı şehzadesidir ve ancak üç yıl saltanat sürmüştür. Tuğrada “Osman Han bin Mustafa el-Muzaffer Daima” yazılıdır. Osmanlı sultanlarının bir tür imzası olan tuğralar, Divan-ı Hümayun üyesi olan nişancı tarafından veya onun talimatı üzerine çekilirdi. Eser, gerek boyutu ve gerekse tuğranın tüm ayrıntılarını gözler önüne serecek kadar ayrıntlı çalışılması nedeniyle Divan-ı Hümayun'da tuğra çekilirken hatasız olarak çekilmesini sağlamak amacıyla yapılmış olmalıdır.

Osmanlı sanatı veya tarihinden söz edildiğinde akla ilk gelen unsurlardan biri de tuğralardır. Sultan III. Osman'a ait tuğra, gerek boyutları gerekse 12. / 18. yüzyıl sanatı'nın etkilerini yansıtması açısından ilginç bir örnektir.
artist: Tuğrayı çeken sanatçı Kaptan-ı Derya Karabağlı Süleyman Paşa’dır (görev süresi: H. 1168 -1171 / M. 1754-1757).
keywords: Ahşap; altın (yaldız); mürekkep; suluboya; boyama

en.name: Joshagan Diamond Design Carpet
description:
An 18th century Joshagan diamond-lozenge design pile carpet. It’s predominantly wine-red centre-field design is placed on an ivory coloured background, and its equally red border design is placed on a dark blue background. The centre-field is dominated by a large diamond-shaped medallion filled with a multi-coloured vegetal Arabesque pattern. The surrounding field is filled with rows of small square compartments set on the diagonal, with each compartment holding a geometric floral form laid out symmetrically. These multi-coloured floral forms are predominantly wine-red and pink in colour with blue, yellow and green details. The dark-blue border holds a chain of geometric arabesque pattern formed of eight-pointed-stars, with each star holding a floral motif.  
  
Joshagan carpets are distinguished in their lozenge designs, where rows of small square lozenges are laid out on the diagonal exemplified by this carpet.
keywords: diagonal grid; floral motifs; medallion; vegetal Arabesque; geometric arabesque
materials: Cotton warp and weft; wool pile

ar.name: مبنى الجامع الكبير في باليرمو داخل كنيسة المتوجة
description: نجد داخل جدران الكنيسة الصغيرة الواقعة خلف الكتدرائية  بعض بقايا قواعد أعمدة تقع وراء المدخل والمذبح، وتحمل سقف بناءٍ ممتدٍ. كان الأغالبة، يستعملون تلك المساحة ( مسجداً، طوله: 18 م وعرضه: 3،8م)، وقد بنوه على أطلال كنيسة بيزنطية، وسموه الجامع الكبير في ( القرن الثالث/ التاسع ).

يقدم هذا القصر المشيد خلال الفترة النورمندية نفس النمطية التي تتواجد بحدائق الملذات بكل من القبة وزيزا وحصن فافارا في ماريدولتشي. كان مجرى مائي يخرجُ عبر مشكاة ذات مقرنصات تقع في القاعة الرئيسية وتنفتح على الحديقة، وكان يسيرُ ، بعد أن يعبر بوابة المدخل، ليزودَ حوضا للسمك، يأخذ نموذج نظام حوض زيزا المائي.
keywords: منشأة دينية.
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

en.name: Uscibene
description:
The palace, now in a state of ruin, probably once consisted of more storeys, and the remains are clearly the ground floor rooms of the body of the main building. This was made up of an *iwan* linked on one side to two large, adjacent rooms (of which only the outer walls remain) and on the other to a vaulted rectangular room – possibly a sirocco room (subterranean cool chamber) – leading to an old natural cave. The *iwan*, still distinguishable, is a cross-vaulted rectangular room with three rectangular niches. The vault of the niche opposite the entrance was decorated with stone and plaster *muqarnas*, of which only traces of the lower part remain. The side niches have umbrella vaults and are still in part recognisable. A stream of water rose from the *muqarnas* niche on the back wall (strategically set against the rocks from which the water rose naturally) and ran through the room and the entrance to the fishpond, in the manner of the pool at Zisa.  
The palace was set in a large garden, now vanished, that was probably a pleasure garden similar to those surrounding the Cuba and Zisa palaces and the Castello della Favara di Maredolce.

This complex, built in Norman times, is similar to the type of pleasure garden found at the Cuba and Zisa palaces and Castle of the Favara at Maredolce. A stream of water rose from the *muqarnas* niche in the main room (which opened onto the garden), ran through the main entrance and fed the fishpond, a system borrowed from the Zisa palace.
keywords: residential architecture
partner: Regione Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

es.name: Uscibene
description:
El palacio, actualmente en estado de ruina, tenía seguramente varios pisos; lo que queda se puede atribuir fácilmente a las salas de la planta baja del cuerpo principal. Éste incluía un *iwan* unido por un lado a dos amplias salas adyacentes (de las que sólo quedan los muros del perímetro) y por el otro a una estancia rectangular abovedada –quizá una “habitación del siroco”– que conducía a una antigua gruta natural. El *iwan*, todavía reconocible, es un espacio rectangular cubierto por una bóveda de crucería con tres hornacinas también rectangulares. La bóveda del nicho que hay frente a la entrada está decorada con mocárabes de piedra y estuco, de los que sólo quedan trazas en la parte inferior; las bóvedas de los dos nichos laterales eran conchas revestidas de estuco, parcialmente visibles aún. De la hornacina de los mocárabes (estratégicamente adosada a la peña de la que el agua manaba naturalmente) brotaba un regato de agua que discurría a través de la habitación hasta desembocar, pasada la puerta de entrada, en un vivero (retomando así el modelo del sistema del estanque de la Zisa).  
Originalmente, el palacio estaba emplazado en el interior de un amplio jardín hoy desaparecido, similar por tanto a los jardines de recreo similar que circundaban los palacios de la Cuba y de la Zisa, así como el Castillo de Favara en Maredolce.

El palacio, levantado en época normanda, puede encuadrarse entre los “solaces” con jardines de recreo, al igual que la Cuba, la Zisa y el Castillo de Favara en Maredolce.  
De un nicho con mocárabes en al ambiente principal, abierto al jardín, provenía un regato de agua que discurría por la sala y que, pasada la puerta de entrada, alimentaba un vivero, retomando así el modelo del sistema del estanque de la Zisa.
dates: Segunda mitad del siglo XII d. C.
keywords: arquitectura residencial
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

fr.name: Uscibene.
description:
Le palais, aujourd'hui en ruine, comportait probablement plusieurs étages ; ce qu'il en reste constituait sans doute les salles du rez-de-chaussée du bâtiment principal. Ce dernier se caractérise par un *iwan* relié d'un côté à deux vastes salles contiguës (dont il ne subsiste que les murs extérieurs), de l'autre à une salle rectangulaire voûtée (peut-être une “chambre du sirocco”) communiquant avec une grotte naturelle attenante. L'*iwan*, encore lisible, est une salle rectangulaire couverte d'une voûte d'arêtes, dotée de trois niches rectangulaires. La voûte de la niche, dans l'axe de l'entrée, était décorée de *mouqarnas* de pierre et de stuc ; il n'en subsiste que quelques traces, sur la partie inférieure ; les voûtes des deux niches latérales étaient constituées de cuvettes en éventail revêtues de stuc, encore partiellement reconnaissables. Dans la niche à *mouqarnas* de la paroi du fond (stratégiquement adossée à une dépression du sol, où se trouvait la source naturelle) jaillissait un filet d'eau qui traversait la salle et qui, au-delà du portail d'entrée, alimentait le vivier, reprenant ainsi le modèle du bassin de la Zisa.  
  
Le palais s'élevait dans un grand jardin aujourd'hui disparu, mais que l'on peut rattacher à la typologie des jardins des délices, analogues à ceux qui entouraient les palais de la Cuba, de la Zisa et du château de la Favara à Maredolce.

Le palais, construit à l'époque des Normands, offre la même typologie que les jardins des délices de la Cuba, de la Zisa et du château de la Favara à Maredolce. Par une niche à *mouqarnas* située dans la salle principale, ouverte sur le jardin, sortait un filet d'eau qui, une fois franchi le portail d'entrée, allait alimenter le vivier, reprenant le modèle du système du bassin hydrique de la Zisa.
keywords: architecture résidentielle
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

it.name: Uscibene.
description: Il palazzo, oggi allo stato di rovina, era probabilmente costituito da più piani: quanto rimane è facilmente attribuibile agli ambienti del piano terra del corpo di fabbrica principale. Quest'ultimo è caratterizzato da un îwân collegato da un lato a due ampie sale contigue (delle quali rimangono soltanto i muri perimetrali), dall'altro ad un ambiente rettangolare coperto a volta (forse una camera dello scirocco) comunicante con un'attigua grotta naturale. L' îwân, ancora leggibile, è un ambiente rettangolare coperto da una volta a crociera e dotato di tre nicchie rettangolari. La volta della nicchia in asse con l'ingresso era decorata da muqarnas in pietra e stucco delle quali restano soltanto alcune tracce nella parte inferiore; le volte delle due nicchie laterali erano costituite da catini a ombrello rivestiti di stucco, ancora in parte riconoscibili. Dalla nicchia con muqarnas della parete di fondo (strategicamente addossata alla balza del terreno in cui si trovava la sorgente naturale) fuoriusciva un rivo d'acqua che attraversava l'ambiente e, oltrepassato il portale d'ingresso, andava ad alimentare la peschiera, riprendendo in questo modo il modello del sistema del bacino idrico della Zisa. Il palazzo faceva parte di un ampio giardino oggi scomparso, riconducibile pertanto alla tipologia dei giardini di delizia, in analogia con quelli circondanti i palazzi della Cuba, della Zisa e del Castello della Favara di Maredolce.

Il palazzo, eretto in epoca normanna, è riconducibile alla tipologia dei giardini di delizia della Cuba, della Zisa e del Castello della Favara di Maredolce.  
Da una nicchia con *muqarnas* nell'ambiente principale, aperto sul giardino, fuoriusciva un rivo d'acqua che, oltrepassato il portale d'ingresso, andava ad alimentare la peschiera, riprendendo in questo modo il modello del sistema del bacino idrico della Zisa.
keywords: architettura residenziale
partner: Regiona Siciliana, Assessorato ai Beni Culturali

en.name: Jewellery for horses – Type 1
short_description: These strings of jewels were used on the horses of Ottoman officials and indicated their high status and wealth. The chain consists of a small, red coral, semi-precious gemstones and silver pendants which would bounce against each other to create a tinkling noise and announce the arrival of the rider.
