en.name: Bowl
description: When Iraqi potters discovered the white-glazed pottery, later known as faience, they also began to use the luster technique. Luster consists of metal oxides applied to pottery that has already been fired. The piece is re-fired at a lower temperature in a reduced-oxygen atmosphere, and the thin decoration takes on a metallic look ranging from copper to gold.
keywords: Bowl; Earthenware
materials: Earthenware, painted in luster over an opaque, white glaze
tags: Earthenware, painted in luster over an opaque, white glaze

ar.name: مدرسة المئذنة المستدقة.
description:
بعض غرف المدرسة لم يعد موجوداً، ولكن هناك فكرة حول مخططه الأصلي يمكن استنباطها من القسم المتبقي ومن الصور الملتقطة في أوائل القرن العشرين. تمَّ بناء المدرسة على بقعة مستطيلة بأبعاد تقريبية 60.23 x 20.30 متراً. الجزء الشرقي من الجانب الشمالي متاخم لمسجد ذي قبة واحدة ورواق بفسحتين مخصصتين للمتأخرين بالقدوم. ويوجد في الركن الجنوبي الشرقي للرواق مئذنة ذات شرفتين. أما المدخل الذي تبلغ أبعاده الأساسية5.50x7.00 أمتار تقريباً فيتسع نحو الخارج من منتصف الجدار الشرقي للمدرسة. وتنتظم غرف المدرسة على الجوانب الشمالية والجنوبية والشرقية للفناء المقبب. فالغرف الشمالية والجنوبية عبارة عن حجرات للطلاب، أما الجهة الغربية فتضم غرفتين شتويتين تفصل بينهما غرفة إيوان. من المعروف أن الدعامات الخارجية التي تدعم الجدارين الغربي والجنوبي للإيوان بنيت عندما كان الوالي فريد باشا حاكماً لقونية عام 1317/ 1899، بعد انهيار الغرفتين الشتويتين. وقد تهدمت الغرف الشتوية والمسجد وحجرات الطلاب ماعدا اثنتين في الجهة الشرقية من الجناح الشمالي. كما ضربت الصاعقة مئذنة المسجد فانهارت فوق الشرفة الأولى في عام 1319 / 1901.  
  
يختلف المدخل الواقع في وسط الجانب الشرقي عن المداخل الأخرى المبنية في الفترة نفسها من حيث الشكل والزخرفة. فقد بني من الحجر، وتمت زخرفته بالنقوش أساساً، مع رسوم هندسية وزهرية أيضاً. ومن الجدير بالاهتمام وجود رسمين لنبات الخرشف (الأرضي شوكي) ضمن الفسحات المثلثية للعقد الرئيسي للمدخل. إضافة إلى ذلك، يوجد على جانب المدخل حليتان على شكل وريدتين نقش المعمار فيهما اسمه، نقرأ في إحداهما "تنفيذ قيلوق" وفي الأخرى "ابن عبد الله." كما يوجد بين المدخل ذي العقد المدبب ومدخل فناء المدرسة حجرة دخول ذات قبو متقاطع.  
  
جرى تدعيم قبة فناء المدرسة بمثلثات كروية مروحية، ويوجد تحت القبة التي ترك قسمها العلوي مفتوحاً حوض مربع الشكل يقع في وسط الفناء. وفي حين أن الجسم الخارجي للمبنى مشيَّد بالحجر، فقد بنيت الأقسام الداخلية من الطوب. كما تمَّ فصل مداخل حجرات الطلاب - التي لم تعد قائمة - عن بعضها بعضاً بواسطة جدران. أما غرفة الإيوان الواقعة في وسط الجهة الغربية للفناء فقد سُقفت بقبو أسطواني الشكل. وهناك، حسب تصورنا، قنطرتان للغرفتين الشتويتين تبرزان فوق مثلثات تركية، لكنهما غير موجودتين الآن أيضاً.  
  
إن العمل الزخرفي للمدرسة تمَّ تنفيذه على المدخل وقبة الفناء وجدران الغرف المقابلة للفناء. كما زخرف مدخل المئذنة وبنيتها الأساسية بالحجر المنحوت والنقوش والرسوم الزهرية والهندسية. أما زخارف الأجزاء الغائرة من النوافذ التي تعلو مداخل حجرات الطلاب، وكذلك قاعدة القبة والمثلثات الكروية المروحية، فتتألف من رسوم زهرية وهندسية منفَّذة بالفسيفساء. كما تمَّ تنفيذ الزخرفة الهندسية لجسم المئذنة وسطح القبة بأشغال الطوب المزجج وغير المزجج.  
  
تحولت المدرسة إلى متحف لأشغال الحجر في عام 1956.
artist: السيد عطا فخر الدين علي (توفي عام 687 / 1288).
keywords: تعليم؛ جلال الدين قاراتاي؛ زخرفة زهرية؛ زخرفة كتابية؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ صاحب عطا فريد الدين علي؛ فسيفساء؛ فن العمارة السلجوقي؛ خزف؛ قونية؛ قيلوق بن عبد الله؛ متحف؛ مدرسة.

en.name: Ince Minareli (‘Slender Minaret’) Madrasa.
description:
Some of the rooms of the *madrasa* are no longer extant. However, an idea of its original plan can be gleaned from the surviving portion as well as from early 20th-century photographs. The *madrasa* was built on a rectangular area measuring approximately 23.60 m x 20.30 m. The east part of the north side is adjoined by a single-domed mosque with a two-bayedportico for latecomers. On the south-east corner of this portico is a minaret with two *şerefe*s, i.e. balconies. A portal whose foundations measure approximately 5.50 m x 7.00 m extends outward from the middle of the *madrasa*'s eastern wall. The rooms of the *madrasa* are arranged on the north, south and west sides of a domed courtyard. The rooms to the north and south are the students' cells, on the west side there were two winter classrooms with a classroom-*iwan* in between them. The outside buttresses which support the *iwan*'s west and south walls are known to have been built when Avlunyalı Ferid Pasha was governor of Konya in 1317 / 1899, after the winter classrooms had collapsed. The winter classrooms, the mosque and all the students' cells except for two on the east side of the north wing, are in ruins. The minaret of the mosque was struck by lightening and collapsed above the first gallery in 1319 / 1901.  
The portal in the centre of the east side differs from other portals of the same period in both its form and its decoration. Built of stone, it is decorated primarily with inscriptions but also with geometric and floral motifs. The two artichoke motifs in the spandrels of the main niche of the portal are interesting. In addition, on the side of the portal are two rosettes in which the architect of the building has placed his name: one has 'work of Kelûk' *('amal-i Kelûk),* the other 'son of Abdullah' *(bin 'Abd Allah).* Between the pointed-arch entranceway of the portal and the *madrasa*'s courtyard is an entrance chamber with a cross-vault.  
The dome over the courtyard of the *madrasa* is supported by fan-shaped pendentives. Below the dome, whose top section is left open, is a square pool in the centre of the courtyard. While the building's exterior is built of stone, the interior sections are made of brick. The entrances to the students' cells, which no longer survive, are walled off. The classroom-*iwan* in the centre of the courtyard's west side is covered with a barrel vault. Each of the winter classrooms on either side of it, which also no longer survive, had a dome rising on Turkish triangles, insofar as we can reconstruct them.  
The decorative work in the *madrasa* occurs in the portal, the courtyard dome and the walls of the rooms facing the courtyard. The portal and the foundations of the minaret are decorated with stone carving using inscriptions and floral and geometric motifs. The decoration of the windows' tympana above the entrances to the students' chambers, the base of the dome and the triangles making up the fan-shaped pendentives, consist of inscriptions and floral and geometric motifs executed in tile-mosaic. The geometric decoration on the body of the minaret and on the surface of the dome is achieved with both glazed and unglazed brickwork.  
The *madrasa* was converted into a Museum of Stonework in 1956.

Most of the *madrasa*s of the Anatolian Seljuq period have one room serving as a *masjid*. However, Ince Minareli Madrasa has a separate *masjid* adjoining it on the outside. This domed *masjid* is preceded by a two-bayed portico and a slim minaret with two balconies, hence the name 'Slender Minaret Madrasa'.
keywords: Konya; museum; Seljuq architecture; education; madrasa; tiles; tile mosaic; floral decoration; geometric decoration; calligraphy; Sahib Ata Fahreddin Ali; Kelûk bin Abdullah.

es.name: Madrasa del Alminar Esbelto (Ince Minare).
description:
A pesar de que algunas de las salas de esta madrasa han desaparecido, su plano original se deduce gracias a las partes que aún siguen en pie, así como a fotografías tomadas a principios del siglo XX. La madrasa se construyó en una superficie rectangular de 23,60 × 23,30 m. Junto a la parte oriental del lado norte hay una mezquita de una sola cúpula con un pórtico de dos naves para los rezagados. En el ángulo sudeste de este pórtico hay un alminar con dos *şerefes* o balcones. Desde la mitad del muro oriental de la madrasa se extiende hacia afuera un portal cuya base mide aproximadamente 5,50 × 7 m. Las salas están dispuestas a lo largo de las caras norte, sur y oeste de un patio con cúpula. Las salas del norte y del sur son celdas para estudiantes, y en el lado oeste hay dos aulas de invierno, con un *iwan*\-aula entre ambas. Se sabe que los contrafuertes exteriores que soportan los muros oeste y sur del *iwan* se construyeron cuando Avlunyali Ferid Paşa era gobernador de Konya, en 1317 / 1899, después de que las aulas de invierno se desplomasen. Estas aulas, la mezquita y todas las celdas de estudiantes, excepto dos del ala norte, están en ruinas. El alminar fue alcanzado por un rayo y se derrumbó sobre la primera galería en 1319 / 1901.  
El portal en el centro de la cara oriental difiere de otros portales del mismo periodo tanto en su forma como en su ornamentación. Es de piedra y está decorado sobre todo con inscripciones, pero también con motivos geométricos y florales. Resultan de interés los dos motivos de alcachofa de las enjutas del nicho principal. A los lados hay dos rosetas en las que el arquitecto escribió su nombre: una dice “obra de Kelûk” y la otra, “hijo de Abdullah”. Entre el portal de acceso –con arco apuntado– y el patio de la madrasa, hay una sala de entrada con una bóveda de crucería.  
La cúpula del patio está sustentada por trompas en forma de abanico. Bajo la cúpula, cuya parte superior está abierta, hay un estanque cuadrado. El exterior del edificio es de piedra, pero el interior es de ladrillo. Las entradas a las celdas de los estudiantes, que no han perdurado, están tapiadas. El *iwan* aula del centro del lado oeste del patio está cubierto por una bóveda de cañón. Todas las aulas de invierno, antaño situadas junto a él pero que no se conservan, estaban cubiertas de cúpulas apoyadas sobre triángulos turcos, en la medida en que se han podido reconstruir.  
La decoración de la madrasa se concentra en el pórtico, la cúpula del patio y las paredes de las salas situadas frente al patio. El pórtico y la base del alminar están decorados con piedra tallada con inscripciones y motivos geométricos y florales. La decoración de los tímpanos de las ventanas sobre las puertas de las celdas, la base de la cúpula y los triángulos que forman las trompas en abanico, presentan inscripciones y motivos geométricos y florales ejecutados en mosaicos de azulejos. La decoración geométrica del alminar y de la superficie de la cúpula se hizo con ladrillos vidriados y sin vidriar.  
En 1956, la madrasa se transformó en el Museo de la Cantería.

La mayoría de las madrasas del periodo selyuquí de Anatolia tienen una sala que sirve de *masyid* (oratorio). Sin embargo, la madrasa del Ince Minare (‘alminar esbelto’) presenta un *masyid* independiente adyacente que está precedido por un pórtico de dos naves y un delgado alminar con dos balcones al que debe su nombre.
keywords: Konya; museo; arquitectura selyuquí; educación; madrasa; azulejos; mosaicos de azulejos; decoración floral; decoración geométrica; caligrafía; Sahib Ata Fahreddin Ali; Kelûk bin Abdullah.

fr.name: Madrasa İnce Minareli (du Minaret effilé).
description:
Si certaines des salles de cette *madrasa* ont disparu, on peut se faire une idée de son plan originel grâce à la partie subsistante et à quelques photographies du début du XXe siècle. L'édifice mesure environ 23,60 x 20,30 m. La partie est du côté nord est adjacente à une mosquée à coupole unique et portique à deux baies prévu pour les retardataires. à l'angle sud-est de ce portique se dresse un minaret à deux *şerefe* (balcons). Un portail dont les fondations mesurent environ 5,50 x 7 m se projette à l'avant du mur oriental. Les salles sont disposées le long des côtés nord, sud et ouest d'une cour couverte d'une coupole. Les salles nord et sud regroupaient les cellules des étudiants tandis que les salles de cours d'hiver flanquant la salle de cours-*iwan* se trouvaient sur le côté ouest. Les contreforts extérieurs qui soutiennent les murs ouest et sud de l'*iwan* sont censés avoir été construits lorsque Avlunyalı Ferid Pacha était gouverneur de Konya en 1317 H / 1899 J.-C., après l'effondrement des salles de cours d'hiver. Celles-ci, la mosquée et toutes les cellules d'étudiants, à l'exception des deux du côté oriental de l'aile nord, sont en ruine. Le minaret a été frappé par la foudre et s'est effondré sur la première galerie en 1319 H / 1901 J.-C. Le portail au centre du côté oriental de l'aile diffère des autres portails de la même période tant par sa forme que par sa décoration. édifié en pierre, il est essentiellement décoré d'inscriptions et des quelques motifs géométriques et floraux, dont deux motifs d'artichauts, qui figurent dans les écoinçons de la niche principale. Sur les côtés se trouvent deux rosettes dans lesquelles l'architecte a fait inscrire son nom. L'une d'elle mentionne “Travail de Kelük” *('amal-i Kelük*), l'autre “Fils d'Abdullah” (*bin Abd Allah*). Entre le passage à arcs brisés du portail et la cour de la *madrasa* se trouve une salle d'entrée à voûtes croisées.  
La coupole au-dessus de la cour est soutenue par des pendentifs en éventail. Sous son oculus central se trouve un bassin carré. Si l'extérieur du bâtiment est en pierre, l'intérieur est en brique. Les entrées aux cellules des étudiants sont murées. L'*iwan*\-salle de cours du milieu du côté ouest de la cour possède une voûte en berceau. Chacune des salles de cours d'hiver qui l'encadrent, également disparues, étaient couvertes de coupoles appuyées sur des triangles turcs, dans la mesure où on a pu les reconstituer.  
Seuls le portail, la coupole de la cour et les murs des salles donnant sur la cour ont été décorés. Le portail et les assises du minaret sont ornés d'un décor sculpté dans la pierre d'inscriptions et de motifs floraux et géométriques. La décoration des tympans des ouvertures au-dessus des entrées des chambres des étudiants, de la base de la coupole et des triangles qui forment les pendentifs en éventail est constituée d'inscriptions et de motifs floraux et géométriques exécutés en mosaïque de carreaux de céramique. Le décor géométrique du minaret et de la coupole faisait appel à des appareils de briques vernissées ou non. La *madrasa* fut reconvertie en Musée du travail de la pierre en 1956.

La plupart des *madrasa* de la période seldjoukide d'Anatolie ont une pièce qui sert de *masjid*. Cependant, la *madrasa* Ince Minareli a un *masjid* séparé, qui lui est relié à l'extérieur. Ce *masjid* à dôme est précédé d'un portique à deux vantaux et d'un fin minaret à deux balcons, d'où le nom “*madrasa* du minaret effilé”.
artist: Sahib Ata Fahreddin [Fakr al-Din] Ali (m. 687 H / 1288 J.-C.).
keywords: Konya ; musées ; architecture seldjoukide ; éducation ; madrasa ; carreaux de céramique ; mosaïque de carreaux ; décoration florale ; décoration géométrique ; calligraphie ; Sahib Ata Fahreddin Ali ; Kelük bin Abdullah ; Ince Minareli

tr.name: İnce Minareli Medrese.
names: İnce Minareli Medrese Taş ve Ahşap Eserler Müzesi.
description:
Medreseyi oluşturan mekanların bazıları günümüzde mevcut değildir. Ancak, gerek yapıdaki izlerden gerekse yayınlardaki fotoğraflardan yapının orijinal planı hakkında fikir edinilebilmektedir. Kuzey-güney yönünde, yaklaşık 23.60 x 20.30 m. ölçülerinde dikdörtgen bir alan üzerine inşa edilmiştir. Kuzey cephesinin doğu ucuna, iki birimli son cemaat yeri olan tek kubbeli bir mescid bitiştirilmiştir. Doğu cephesinde yer alan son cemaat yerinin güneydoğu köşesinde, iki şerefeli minare vardır. Medresenin doğu cephesinin ortasına yerleştirilmiş, yaklaşık 5.50 x 7.00 metre ölçülerine sahip taçkapı kuruluşu cepheden dışa taşıntı yapmaktadır. Medreseyi oluşturan mekanlar, bir kubbe ile örtülü bir avlunun kuzey, güney ve batı kenarlarına yerleştirilmişlerdir. Avlunun kuzey ve güney kenarlarında öğrenci hücreleri; batı kenarında ise, iki kışlık dershane mekanı ile bunların arasına inşa edilmiş dershane eyvanı bulunmaktadır. Eyvanın batı ve güney duvarlarını dıştan destekleyen payandaların, kışlık dershaneler yıkıldıktan sonra, 1317 / 1899 tarihinde Avlunyalı Ferid Paşa'nın Konya Valiliği sırasında inşa edildikleri bilinmektedir. Kışlık dershaneler, mescid ve kuzey kanadının doğu ucundaki ikisi dışındaki tüm öğrenci hücreleri yıkılmıştır. Mescide ait minarenin, birinci şerefeye kadar olan kesimi 1319 / 1901 tarihinde bir yıldırım sonucu yıkılmıştır.  
  
Doğu cephesinin ortasındaki taçkapı, gerek formu gerekse süslemeleri bakımından, döneminin diğer taçkapı örneklerinden farklıdır. Taş ile inşa edilmiş taçkapı, yazı örnekleri başta olmak üzere, geometrik ve bitkisel motiflerle süslenmiştir. Taçkapı ana nişinin üst köşelerine yerleştirilmiş iki enginar motifi ilginçtir. Ayrıca, taçkapı cephesinde, birinde “Amel-i Kelûk”, diğerinde “bin Abdullah” yazılı iki rozet içerisinde yapının mimarının adı verilmiştir. Taçkapıdaki sivri kemerli giriş ile medrese avlusu arasında, üzeri bir çapraz tonozla örtülü giriş mekanı vardır.  
  
Medrese avlusunu örten kubbeye yelpaze pandantiflerle geçilmiştir. üst kesimi açık bırakılan kubbenin altında, avlunun ortasında kare şekilli havuz bulunmaktadır. Yapının dışı taşlarla inşa edilmişken, iç kesimlerin tuğlalarla inşa edildiği görülmektedir. Günümüzde mevcut olmayan öğrenci hücrelerinin girişleri örülerek kapatılmıştır. Avlunun batı kenarının ortasına yerleştirilmiş dershane eyvanı beşik tonoz ile örtülüdür. Eyvanın iki yanına yerleştirilen, ancak günümüzde mevcut olmayan kışlık dershane mekanlarının Türk üçgenleriyle geçilmiş birer kubbe ile örtülü oldukları, günümüze kalan izlerden anlaşılmaktadır.  
  
Medresedeki süslemeler taçkapı, minare, avlu kubbesi ve medreseyi oluşturan mekanların avluya bakan cephelerinde yer almaktadır. Taçkapı ve minarenin kaidesindeki süslemeler taş üzerine kabartma tekniği ile yapılmıştır. Bu süslemelerde yazı örnekleri ile bitkisel ve geometrik motifler kullanılmıştır. öğrenci hücrelerinin girişleri üstünde yer alan pencerelerin alınlıklarında, kubbe eteğinde ve yelpaze pandantifleri oluşturan üçgen dilimlerin arasında, yazı örnekleri ile bitkisel ve geometrik motiflerin bulunduğu süslemeler çini mozaik tekniği ile yapılmışlardır. Minare gövdesi ve kubbe yüzeyindeki geometrik süslemelerde ise, sırlı ve sırsız tuğlalar kullanılmıştır.  
  
Medrese 1956 yılında taş eserleri müzesi olarak hizmete açılmıştır.

Anadolu Selçukluları dönemi medreselerinin birçoğunda mekânlardan biri mescit olarak düzenlenmiştir. İnce Minareli Medrese'de ise mescit, yapının dışına inşa edilmiştir. Harimi bir kubbe ile örtülü mescidin iki birimli bir son cemaat yeri ve iki şerefeli bir minaresi vardır.
keywords: Konya; Müze; Selçuklu mimarisi; Eğitim; Medrese; Çini; Çini-mozaik; bitkisel bezeme; geometrik bezeme; Sahip Ata Fahreddin Ali; Kelûk bin Abdullah

en.name: Villa Albergati
description:
The vast building stands in the countryside. It is impressive for its remarkable size and the severe, massive aspect of the exterior which is quite unusual for a Villa. We know that the original plan for the exterior decoration with stairs, statues and freezes was not realised. Its exceptional extension in height, 4 floors plus the clock tower, is exceptional.  
In the middle of the building stands the magnificent white triple volume ballroom, with stucco decoration.  
The complex decorative cycle of painted ceilings includes two main halls and several rooms, each of them shows different original illusionist architectural paintings (quadratura). Allegories and episodes from mythology are the subjects of the painted ceilings. This is a common theme in spaces intended to host feasts and leisure events, such as this villa.  
The most important artists working in Bologna at the time were employed in this vast enterprise: Angelo Michele Colonna and Giacomo Alboresi, Giovanni Antonio Burrini and Marcantonio Chiarini, Vittorio Maria Bigari and Stefano Orlandi.  
The decorations date from 1665 to the second half of the eighteenth-century.  
On the ground floor one can admire an original example of the so-called “boschereccia” decoration. This is a room painted entirely with trees and vineyards, to simulate a landscape surrounding the visitor. It was originally used as a dining room. It was painted around 1776-1778 by Prospero and Gaetano Pesci.

The monumental and sumptuous villa of the noble Albergati family stands in the fertile countryside around Bologna and can be considered one of the most significant examples of Italian seventeenth-century residential architecture.  
The uniqueness of this building is due to the magnificent ballroom occupying the centre of it: a sort of translation in architectural language and white stuccoes of the illusory painted perspectives known as “quadratura” that can be admired on the ceilings of the other rooms.
artist: Architect: Giovan Giacomo Monti (1620–1692); painters: Angelo Michele Colonna (1604–1687) and Giuseppe Alboresi (1632–1677); painter: Antonio Burrini (1656–1727); Marcantonio Chiarini (1652–1734); Vittorio Maria Bigari (1692–1776); Stefano Orlandi (1681–1760); Prospero (1710–1784) and Gaetano Pesci (?)
history:
The patron, Marquis Girolamo Albergati Capacelli, was a representative of one of the most important and admired Bolognese Families.  
Little is known about his life but it is known that he was successful in completing two great architectural enterprises: the long porticoes to the shrine of San Luca in Bologna and his villa in the country. This villa was known as “Regio Palazzo”, “royal Palace”, because of its splendour and grandeur. It has been called the most complex and ambitious enterprise of the time: it took almost 30 years to be completed.  
During the eighteenth-century, the palace was a lively centre for cultural and social activities, hosting popes, kings, princes, musicians, men and women of letters, and even famous adventurers. The theatre within the villa was famous for the representations of plays written by the patron Marquis Francesco Albergati Capacelli. He was a theatre lover and friend of some famous playwrights of the time including Voltaire, Alfieri and Goldoni.
keywords: Villa; Quadratura; aristocracy residences; Ballroom; Gian Giacomo Monti; *Allegory of Time*; Angelo Michele Colonna; Giuseppe Alboresi; *Phaeton*; Antonio Burrini; Figural decoration; Fresco
partner: Musei Civici d’Arte Antica di Bologna in cooperation with the Province of Bologna

it.name: Villa Albergati
description:
Il vasto edificio si trova in campagna e colpisce per la vastità e l'aspetto esterno, severo e massiccio, piuttosto insolito in una villa. Sappiamo che un progetto per la decorazione dell'esterno con scale, statue e fregi non fu mai realizzato. La sua eccezionale estensione in altezza, 4 piani più la torre dell'orologio, è anch'essa insolita.  
Al centro dell'edifiio si alza la magnifica, candida sala da ballo dal volume triplo, decorata in stucco.  
Il complesso insieme decorativo di soffitti dipinti comprende due atrii e varie stanze, ciascuna delle quali mostra soluzioni differenti e originali per la quadratura. Allegorie ed episodi tratti dalla mitologia sono il soggetto dei soffitti dipinti, un carattere comune ai luoghi nati per ospitare feste e divertimenti, come questa villa.  
In questa vasta impresa furono impiegati gli artisti più importanti che lavoravano a Bologna in questo periodo: Angelo Michele Colonna e Giacomo Alboresi, Giovanni Antonio Burrini e Marcantonio Chiarini, Vittorio Maria Bigari e Stefano Orlandi.  
Le decorazioni datano dal 1665 alla seconda metà del XVIII secolo.  
Al piano terra si ammira un esempio originale della cosiddetta “boschereccia”: una stanza completamente dipinta con paesaggi, alberi e vigneti che fingono uno spazio aperto attorno al visitatore. Era destinata in origine ad ospitare una sala da pranzo e fu decorata attorno al 1776-1778 da Prospero e Gaetano Pesci.

La sontuosa e monumentale villa della nobile famiglia Albergati si trova nella fertile pianura attorno a Bologna e si può considerare uno degli esempi più significativi di architettura residenziale italiana del XVIII secolo.  
L'unicità di questo edificio si deve in particolare alla magnifica sala da ballo che ne occupa il centro: una sorta di traduzione in linguaggio architettonico e stucco candido della pittura prospettica illusiva nota come “quadratura” che si può ammirare nei soffitti delle altre stanze della villa.
artist: Architetto: Gian Giacomo Monti; pittori: Angelo Michele Colonna and Giuseppe Alboresi; pittore: Antonio Burrini (1656–1727); Marcantonio Chiarini (1652–1734); Vittorio Maria Bigari (1692–1776); Stefano Orlandi (1681–1760); Prospero (1710–1784) e Gaetano Pesci (?)
history:
Il committente, il marchese Girolamo Albergati Capacelli, apparteneva and una delle più importanti e stimate famiglie bolognesi.  
Non sappiamo molto della sua vita tranne che era determinato a portare a termine due grandi imprese architettoniche: il lungo portico che conduce al santuario di S. Luca a Bologna e la sua villa di campagna. Per il suo splendore e ampiezza, fin dall'inizio la villa fu chiamata “Regio Palazzo”, ed è stata sentita come la più complessa e ambiziosa impresa del tempo: ci vollero circa 30 anni per completarla.  
Durante il XVIII secolo il palazzo fu un vivace centro della vita culturale e sociale, ospitò papi, re, principi, musicisti, uomini e donne di lettere, e anche celebri avventurieri. Il teatro costruito al suo interno divenne celebre per le rappresentazioni di spettacoli scritti dal marchese Francesco Albergati Capacelli stesso, amante del teatro e amico di alcuni famosi autori dell'epoca come  Voltaire, Alfieri e Goldoni.
keywords: Villa; Quadratura; residenze dell'aristocrazia; Sala da ballo; Gian Giacomo Monti; *Allegoria del Tempo*; Angelo Michele Colonna; Giuseppe Alboresi; *Fetonte*; Antonio Burrini; decorazione figurata; Affresco

ar.name: دورق فولاذيَ للبودرة
description: يُظهر دورق البودرة هذا أحد السنوريات وهو يهاجم ثورًا، وهو شعار شرق أوسطي قديم يرمز إلى الحاكم القوي الذي يهزم خصمه الضعيف. وفي الوقت الذي ابتُكرت فيه هذه القطعة، كان الجيش الفارسي يخوض مرحلة من التجديد على الطراز الأوروبي لفترة من الوقت. وبناءً عليه يُحتمل ألا تكون هذه القطعة قد صُنعت للاستخدام الفعلي بل إنها ابتكرت كتحفة فنية شاهدة على أحداث تاريخية.
dates: أواخر القرن الثالث عشر الهجري/ أواخر القرن التاسع عشر الميلادي

en.name: Steel powder flask
description: This powder flask shows a feline attacking a bull, an age-old Middle Eastern symbol of a powerful ruler defeating his weaker foe. By the time this piece was made, the Persian army had been undergoing western-style modernization for some time. It is therefore likely that rather than being made for actual use, it was created as a historicizing curio.
dates: Hegira late 13th century / AD late 19th century
keywords: Flask; Iran; Metalwork; military object; arms; armours; military wear; warfare

en.name: *Chateaubriand at the ruins of Carthage*
short_description: This engraving of the French poet René de Chateaubriand shows him sitting on a hill facing the sea, surrounded by the ruins of Carthage. Fascinated by Didon's city and its glorious past, the poet visited Carthage in January 1807, and recorded his observations in his book entitled *Itinéraire de Paris à Jérusalem et de Jérusalem à Paris en Allant par la Grèce, en Revenant par l’Egypte*, published in Paris in 1811 by Lenormant, in three volumes.
holder: Institut Supérieur d’Histoire Contemporaine de la Tunisie
keywords: Chateaubriand; Carthage; archaeological site
partner: Higher Institute for the Study of Contemporary History of Tunisia, University of Manouba

fr.name: *Chateaubriand aux ruines de Carthage*
short_description: Gravure représentant le poète français François-René de Chateaubriand sur un monticule face à la mer, entouré des vestiges de Carthage. Fasciné par la cité de Didon et son glorieux passé antique, le poète a visité Carthage en janvier 1807. Ses impressions furent consignées dans son ouvrage intitulé *Itinéraire de Paris à Jérusalem et de Jérusalem à Paris en allant par la Grèce, en revenant par l’Egypte*, Paris, Lenormant, 1811, 3 vol.
holder: Institut supérieur d’Histoire contemporaine de la Tunisie
keywords: Chateaubriand; Carthage; Site archéologique
partner: Institut Supérieur d’histoire contemporaine de la Tunisie, Université de la Manouba

en.name: Madrasa of Umm al-Sultan Sha‘ban
description:
Al-Sultan Sha‘ban, grandson of al-Nasir Muhammad, had this *madrasa* built for his mother Khuwand Barka in the year 770/1369. Its layout is that of the classic cruciform *madrasa* with four *iwans* around a *durqa‘a* or open central courtyard. Furnished with the traditional elements (watering trough, *sabil*, *kuttab*, students’ room, prayer hall, minaret and two mausoleums), one of its most outstanding features is the way in which it is woven into the urban fabric.  
The *madrasa* is located on Bab al-Wazir, the main street leading to the Citadel. The minaret and main *qubba* are strategically placed in the far south east of the *madrasa* on a corner with a smaller street and thus clearly visible to the Sultan’s procession on his return to the Citadel.  
Of the two entrances to the *madrasa*, the main one is characterised by its unusual design of Seljuq influence, characterised by the lancet arch filled with nine rows of gilt *muqarnas* decorated with leaf design. To the left of this innovative entrance overlooking Bab al-Wazir Street is the *sabil* façade. It is formed by a wooden screen of individual panels that interlock to form geometric shapes: it is believed to be the first example of its kind.  
There are two *qubbas*, one on either side of the *qibla iwan*. The southwestern *qubba* houses the tombs of Khuwand Barka (buried in 774/1373) and her daughter. The south-eastern *qubba* is larger and houses the tombs of Sultan Sha‘ban (buried in 778/1377) and one of his sons. Both stone domes bear the same exterior decoration of vertical ribs dividing them into segments. The minaret, however, preserves only two of its three original sections. The lower section is octagonal with alternating blind and open pointed arches resting on double columns, with a balcony resting on rows of *muqarnas*. The second, while smaller, is also octagonal decorated with a horizontal chevron design.

es.name: Madrasa de Umm al-Sultán Cha‘ban
description:
El sultán Cha‘ban, nieto de al-Nasir Muhammad, erigió esta *madrasa* para su madre Juwand Barka en el año 770/1369. El edificio, de planta cruciforme, se organiza con cuatro *iwan*s en torno a una *durqa‘a* o patio central descubierto. Dotado de los clásicos anejos para sus diferentes funciones (abrevadero, *sabil*, *kuttab*, habitaciones para estudiantes, sala de oración, alminar y dos mausoleos), una de sus particularidades reside en su imbricación en el tejido urbano.  
La *madrasa* está situada sobre la calle principal, Bab Zuwayla, que conduce hasta la Ciudadela, en un ángulo con una calle secundaria. El alminar y la *qubba* principal se han colocado de manera estratégica en su extremo sureste, para que fuesen visibles durante el cortejo del sultán, de retorno a la Ciudadela.  
De los dos accesos de esta *madrasa*, el principal se caracteriza por lo insólito de su diseño de influencia selyuquí, con el arco apuntado alancetado, relleno por nueve hileras de mocárabes dorados y decorados con hojas vegetales.  
A la izquierda de esta innovadora entrada, sobre la calle Bab al-Wazir, la fachada del *sabil* se compone de una celosía de madera ensamblada que, con sus motivos geométricos, se considera el primer ejemplo de este tipo.  
En cuanto a las dos *qubba*s que flanquean el *iwan* de la *qibla*, la suroeste alberga las tumbas de Juwand Barka (enterrada en 774/1373) y su hija, en tanto que la sureste, más grande, alberga las del sultán Cha‘ban (enterrado en 778/1377) y uno de sus hijos. Las dos cúpulas de piedra presentan una decoración exterior con nervaduras verticales en forma de gajos, mientras que el alminar conserva solo dos de sus tres fustes. El primero, de forma octogonal, tiene en sus lados arcos angulares sobre dobles columnas, con alternancia de uno ciego y otro con ventana, y balcón sobre mocárabes. El segundo, también octogonal, es de menor tamaño, con decoración de zigzags horizontales.

fr.name: Madrasa de Oum al-Sultan Cha‘ban
description:
Le sultan Cha‘ban, petit-fils de al-Nasir Muhammad, fit construire cette *madrasa* pour sa mère Khuwand Barka en 770/1369. Cette *madrasa* à plan cruciforme s’organise avec quatre i*wan*s autour d’une *durqa‘a* ou cour centrale découverte. Dotée des classiques annexes dédiées aux différentes fonctions (abreuvoir, *sabil*, *kuttab*, chambres pour les étudiants, salle de prière, minaret et deux mausolées), une de ses particularités réside dans son imbrication dans le tissu urbain.  
Donnant sur la rue principale, Bab Zuwayla, qui conduit jusqu’à la Citadelle, à l’angle d’une rue secondaire, le minaret et la *koubba* principale ont été placés de manière stratégique à l’extrémité sud-est de la *madrasa* pour être visibles pendant la procession du sultan, sur le trajet de retour à la Citadelle.  
Des deux accès de cette *madrasa*, le principal se signale par le côté insolite de sa physionomie d’inspiration seldjoukide. L’arc brisé lancéolé est meublé de neuf rangées de *mouqarnas* dorés et décorés de motifs végétaux.  
À gauche de cette innovante entrée, sur la rue Bab al-Wazir, la façade du *sabil* se compose d’une jalousie en bois assemblé qui, avec ses motifs géométriques, est considérée comme le premier exemple de ce type.  
Quant aux *koubba*s qui flanquent l’iwan de la *qibla*, celle du sud-ouest abrite les tombes de Khuwand Barka (enterrée en 774/1373) et de sa fille, tandis que celle du sud-est, plus grande, abrite celles du sultan Cha‘ban (enterré en 778/1377) et de l’un de ses fils. Les deux coupoles godronnées en pierre sont décorées de profondes nervures verticales, tandis que le minaret ne conserve que deux de ses trois fûts d’origine. Le premier, de forme octogonale, présente sur les côtés des arcs angulaires sur colonnes doubles – un arc aveugle alternant avec un arc à fenêtre et balcon sur *mouqarna*s. Le second, également octogonal, est de plus petites dimensions et présente une décoration de zigzags horizontaux.

ar.name: ثوبخضاري
description:
ثوب ملك مصنوع من قماش أبو وردة وقماش الأخضيري، بألوان أخضر، برتقالي وخمري، وأسود. مطرز يدوياً، يحتوي على قبة مطرزة بشكل القوار (قبة الملك التقليدية)، ويعلو القبة قطعتين من قماش مخمل أزرق مطرز عليها شكل طير. أكمام الثوب عريضة، مصنوعة من قماش حرير هرموزي، على شكل الساعة التلحمية ومغطاة بزخرفة عصفور. أما التطريز على الصدر فمن الدرزات التقليدية لفستان الملك بزخارف نباتية، في حين أن فتحة العنق والأكتاف مصنوعة من قماش أبو وردة، متصلة بالصدر بخط من المخمل الخمري. الردهة الأمامية مكونة من ألوان القماش الأصلية بدون تطريز، أما الردهة الخلفية للثوب يظهر عليها أربعة خطوط أفقية من القماش. أما جوانب الثوب (البنايق) فمصنوعة من الحرير، ومتصلة بباقي أجزاء الثوب من خلال المناجل (جديلة سميكة تربط أجزاء الثوب معاً) بزخارف نباتية بسيطة في الأسفل ، وزخارف نباتية، وبعض الصلبان. هذا الثوب ترتديه النساء لحفلات الزفاف والمناسبات الخاصة الأخرى.  
تاريخ الحصول على القطعة: 1983 م.
dates: النصف الأول من القرن التاسع عشر
keywords: تقليدي، منسوجات فلسطينية، ثوب

en.name: Ikhdari Dress (*Malaq*)
description: *Malaq* dress made of *Abu Warda* fabric and *Ikhdari* fabric with green, burgundy, orange and black stripes. The dress has a chest panel embroidered with the image of a vase (the traditional chest panel of a *malaq* garment) and is adorned with two pieces of blue velvet embroidered with a bird. The sleeves are wide, made of *Hormozi* silk fabric, with an *Al-Talhami* clock shape and embellished with a bird motif. Embroidery on the chest panel resembles the traditional stitch of *malaq* dress with floral motifs, while the collar on the neck and shoulders is made with pink cloth and connected to the chest panel by a line of russet velveteen trim. The front of the dress shows the original fabric colors without embroidery, while the back panel shows four horizontal stripes of the fabric. The *banayeq* (side panels) are of silk cloth and are connected to the dress by *manajel* (thick braid work connecting the dress parts). The bottom sections of the *banayeq* are adorned with simple floral motif embroidery and some crosses. This dress is worn by women for weddings and other special occasions.
keywords: Traditional costume; Palestinian textile; Dress; Clothing

en.name: Citroën DS 21
description: After the success of the Traction Avant and the groundbreaking 2CV, Citroën outdid itself with the DS. Apart from its exceptionally comfortable suspension, the car’s underlying technology was not particularly extraordinary. However, Italian designer Flaminio Bertoni had mastered his craft to such an extent that he created a true revolution. The DS’s sophisticated styling and engineering sent shockwaves through the automotive world, with even luxury brands panicking as Citroën offered such refinement at highly competitive prices. Thankfully for them, the DS remained an outlier; even 60 years later, no one has managed to replicate Bertoni’s masterpiece. To this day, nearly all car designers regard the DS as their greatest source of inspiration, and museums are eager to display it as an iconic design piece.
keywords: Hydropneumatic suspension; futuristic design; fiberglass roof; innovation

en.name: Cupola
description: This was the first cupola built in Portugal, similar to that of St. Peter’s in Rome. Sixty-two metres high, it is marble outside and with polychrome marble inside. The cupola has an eight-sided form and eight windows, above which are the sculpted litanies of the Virgin Mary. Forty-one men worked simultaneously on the decoration “very well and at ease”, according to a testimony in contemporary sources.
partner: Institute for the Administration of Architectural and Archaeological Heritage -  IGESPAR

pt.name: Cúpula/Zimbório. Exterior em mármore branco, interior em mármores policromos
description: Com 62 metros de altura, foi a primeira cúpula executada em Portugal, à semelhança da de S. Pedro de Roma. Sobre as janelas, estão esculpidas as litanias da Virgem. O interior, de forma oitavada e com oito janelas, tem cerca de 9,68 metros de perímetro. Na sua decoração, segundo fontes da época, trabalharam quarenta e um homens “*muito bem e à vontade*”.

ar.name: نقش من خندق قلعة القدس.
description: القطعة عبارة عن نقش رخامي تأسيسي كبير الحجم يؤرخ لحفر خندق حول سور مدينة القدس القديمة في العصر الأيوبي، بغرض حماية المدينة من غزوات جديدة محتملة من قبَل الصليبيين. أشرف على حفر الخندق الاسفهسلار علي بن أحمد الهكاري (توفي عام 588 / 1192). وقد كتب هذا النقش بعد معركة حطين بأربعة أعوام. ويبدو أن النقش نقل إلى الحرم الشريف خلال تعمير أسوار المدينة أثناء حكم السلطان العثماني سليمان القانوني (حكم في الفترة 926 – 974 / 1520 - 1566). كتب نص النقش في ستة سطور بالخط النسخي الأيوبي المشكول البارز. ويفيدنا هذا النص معلومات عن عصر صلاح الدين الأيوبي، وعن الأساليب الدفاعية التي كانت تتبع لحماية المدينة، مثل حفر هذا الخندق خارج أسوار المدينة بعد أن تم تحرير المدينة من الصليبيين. أمّا نص النقش فهو كما يلي: "بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم وصلواته على محمد النبي واله امر بعمارته وحفر الخندق مولانا الملك الناصر صلاح الدنيا والدين سلطان الاسلام والمسلمين خادم الحرمين الشريفين وهذا البيت المقدس ابو المظفر يوسف بن ايوب محيي دولة امير المؤمنين ادام الله ايامه ونصر اعلامه في ايام الامير الاسفهسلار الكبير سيف الدين علي بن احمد اعزه الله في سنة سبع وثمانين وخمسمائة للهجرة الشريفة."

بعد ان استعاد صلاح الدين الأيوبي مدينة القدس من أيدي الفرنجة، قام بتحصين المدينة، وإعادة بناء قلعتها، وحفر خندقاً لها، يساهم في الدفاع عنها أمام حملات فرنجة جديدة. والنقش هنا يدلل على هذه الأعمال، ويذكر النقش السلطان، وقائد عسكره. النقش مثبت الآن في ساحة "قبة الصخرة".
keywords: خندق؛ خندق القدس؛ لوحة رخامية؛ نقش.

en.name: Marble inscription panel.
description:
A large, marble inscription panel produced to mark the foundation of the trench around the fortification wall of the old city of Jerusalem during the Ayyubid period. Produced four years after the Battle of Hattin, the panel was made with the aim that it would protect the city from new incursions launched by the Crusaders. Al-Asfahsalar Ali bin Ahmad al-Hikkari (d. AH 588 / AD 1192) supervised the digging of the trench.  
It is probable that the inscription panel was taken to the Haram al-Sharif while repairs to the city walls were being carried out during the reign of the Ottoman Sultan, Sulayman al-Qanuni (known in the West as Sulayman the Magnificent; r. AH 926–74 / AD 1520–66). The inscription is laid out in six lines of cursive Ayyubid *naskhi* script carved in high relief. The text offers an insight into the period of Salah al-Din Ayyubi (Saladin), founder of the Ayyubid Dynasty, and the defensive techniques employed in order to protect the city from the Crusaders, such as the ditch that was excavated around the citadel following the successful liberation of the city. The inscription reads as follows:  
“In the Name of God the most Beneficent, the most Merciful  
And Blessings be upon Muhammad, the Prophet and his household.  
The order to build this and to dig the trench was given by our master, the Victorious Sovereign, the Salvation of this world and religion, Sultan of Islam and the Muslims,  
Servant of the two holy sanctuaries and this holy abode, Abu al-Muzaffar Yusuf bin Ayyub,  
Reviver of the State, Commander of the Faithful, May God lengthen his days and support his star in the days of the great Amir, al-Asfahasalar Sayf al-Din Ali bin Ahmad, may God strengthen him in AH 587 \[c. 1191\]”.

After Salah al-Din Ayyubi (Saladin) reconquered Jerusalem from the Crusaders, he renovated its citadel and dug a trench to improve the city’s defences against fresh attack from the Crusaders. This inscription affirms these works and mentions the sultan and a commander of his troops. The panel is now in the plaza of the Dome of the Rock.
holder: Islamic Museum, al-Aqsa Mosque / Al-Haram al-Sharif.
keywords: Marble; panel; inscription

es.name: Lápida de mármol con inscripción.
description:
Gran lápida de mármol fundacional del foso que rodea la muralla que protegía la antigua ciudad de Jerusalén en época ayyubí. El foso se construyó bajo la supervisión de al-Asfahsalar Ali ibn Ahamd al-Hikkari (m. 588 / 1192) cuatro años después de la batalla de Hittin con el objetivo de proteger la ciudad de las incursiones de los cruzados.  
Es probable que el panel se llevase al Haram al-Sharif durante las obras de restauración de las murallas realizadas por el sultán otomano Suleyman al-Qanuni (conocido en Occidente como Suleyman el Magnífico, r. 926-974 / 1520-1566). La inscripción consta de seis líneas en letra cursiva de estilo *nasji* ayyubí en altorrelieve. El texto permite acercarse al periodo de Salah al-Din Ayyubi (Saladino), fundador de la dinastía ayyubí, y da idea de las técnicas utilizadas para proteger la ciudad de los cruzados, como la zanja que se excavó alrededor de la alcazaba tras la liberación de la ciudad.  
La inscripción dice así:  
“En el nombre de Dios, el más misericordioso, el más piadoso. / Que las bendiciones sean con Muhammad, el Profeta, y su familia. / La orden de construir y excavar este foso procedió de nuestro maestro, el / soberano victorioso, la salvación de este mundo y la religión, el sultán del Islam y los musulmanes, / servidor de los dos santuarios sagrados y su santa morada, Abu al-Muzaffar Yusuf ibn Ayyub, / restablecedor del Estado, comandante de los fieles, que Dios le otorgue una larga vida y / sustente su estrella en los días del gran emir al-Asfahasalar Saif al-Din Ali bin / Ahmad, que Dios le dé fuerza. En el año 587 \[1191\]”.

Tras la reconquista de Jerusalén, Salah al-Din Ayyubi (Saladino) mandó renovar la ciudadela y construir una trinchera para mejorar la defensa de la ciudad contra posibles ataques de los cruzados. La inscripción menciona estos trabajos, junto con el nombre del sultán y el del comandante de sus tropas. Actualmente, esta lápida está en la plaza de la Cúpula de la Roca.
dates: Año 587 de la Hégira / 1191 d. C.
keywords: Panel; mármol; inscripción.
partner: Museo islámico en la mezquita de Al-Aqsa

fr.name: Panneau épigraphié en marbre.
description:
Grand panneau épigraphié en marbre réalisé pour célébrer le creusement d'un fossé autour du mur de fortification de la vieille ville de Jérusalem au cours de la période ayyoubide. Creusé quatre ans après la bataille de Hattin, sous la supervision d'al-Asfahsalar Ali bin Ahmad al-Hikkari (mort en 588 H / 1192 J.-C.), ce fossé était censé protéger la ville des incursions des croisés.  
Il est probable que le panneau a été transféré au Haram al-Charif lorsque les murailles ont été restaurées sous le règne du sultan ottoman Sulayman al-Qanuni (Soliman le Magnifique, r. 926-974 H / 1520-1566 J.-C.). L'inscription, sculptée en haut relief, comprend six lignes de style *naskhi* ayyoubide. Le texte éclaire sur la période de Saladin, fondateur de la dynastie ayyoubide, et sur les techniques de défense utilisées pour protéger la ville, parmi lesquelles ce fossé creusé après la libération de Jérusalem. Le texte de l'inscription est le suivant :  
“Au nom de Dieu, le plus Bienfaisant, le plus Miséricordieux,  
Que soient bénis Muhammad, le Prophète, et sa descendance.  
L'ordre d'édifier ceci et de creuser le fossé a été donné par notre maître, le Victorieux Souverain, le Salut de ce monde et de la religion, Sultan de l'Islam et des Musulmans,  
Serviteur des deux sanctuaires sacrés et de ce lieu saint, Abou al-Mudaffar Youssouf bin Ayyoub,  
Restaurateur de l'état, Commandeur des Fidèles, que Dieu allonge ses jours et soutienne son étoile au temps du grand émir al-Asfahsalar Saif al-Din Ali bin Ahmad, que Dieu lui donne la force en 587 \[1191\].”

Lorsque Salah al-Din Ayyoubi (Saladin) eut repris Jérusalem aux Croisés, il rénova la citadelle et fit creuser un fossé pour protéger la ville de nouvelles attaques des Croisés. Cette inscription authentifie ces travaux et mentionne le sultan et le commandant de ses troupes. Ce panneau se trouve aujourd’hui sur la place du Dôme du Rocher.
holder: Musée islamique, mosquée al-Aqsa / Haram al-Charif.
keywords: Panneaux ; marbre ; inscriptions

en.name: Photograph
short_description:
This photograph is taken from a family photograph album. Most of the photographs in it are printed on platinum paper, which was introduced in 1879.  
Throughout most of the 19th century women had few legal rights to property, money, children, or even, after marriage, their own bodies. However, there were great changes in attitudes during the last decade of the century. The traditional role of women was questioned and some women openly defied convention. They educated themselves by reading widely and took up what were seen as 'un-ladylike' activities such as smoking and cycling. The free movement of the bicycle was seen as a symbol of equality and personal freedom.
keywords: Photographs; women

en.name: Altar of St. John of Nepomuk
description: An elegant combination of violet and white marble gives the impression of lightness despite the strict classical architectural elements of this altar. Pairs of columns support the architrave and the attic. The central niche, flanked by a pair of columns, holds the sculpture of St. John of Nepomuk while the side sculptures personify Hope and Faith and are much smaller in scale. It is thought that the altar design was from Vienna and the marble imported from Italy. Master sculptors also came from Venice, but it is still uncertain who they were.

ar.name: شاهدة قبر رخامية، أسطوانية الشكل، عليها نقوش عربية بخط كوفي.
description:
شاهدة قبر رخامية، أسطوانية الشكل، لحق بعض الأضرار بقسمها السفلي الخالي من الزخرفة. أما القسم العلوي ففيه زخرفة بسيطة. والسطح الأسطواني مقسم على 10 أسطر منقوشة بخط كوفي، ويعود تاريخه إلى القرن(السادس/ الثاني عشر).  
نصه المكتوب هو التالي: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم، صلى الله على النبي محمد وعلى آله أجمعين. هذا قبر عمر بن أبي بكر الشعيري الذي ُتوفي يوم الاثنين الثامن من شهر ذي الحجة من سنة خمسة مائة، وبقية تحديد السنة الهجرية كاملة، ليست موجودة. رأى السيد م. أماري المترجم من العربية إلى الإيطالية أن التاريخ هو سنة 615 / 1219، ورأى واضع الفهرس الزمني للشواهد العربية أن التاريخ هو سنة 1515/ 1122 لأن الخط الكوفي مناسب لهذا الزمن.
إن النمطية الخاصة على شكل "عمود صغير" لهذه الشاهدة الجنائزية تحدد انتماءها إلى إطار جغرافي دقيق: إيطاليا الجنوبية. ومن الممكن التعرف على النموذج الأولي لها في مصر، ضمن قطع ترجع إلى القرن 10.
keywords: خط كوفي؛ شاهدة قبر؛ نقش

en.name: Cylindrical marble memorial stone with Arabic inscription in *kufic* characters.
description:
Cylindrical marble memorial stone, damaged at the bottom, undecorated but for a simple moulding on the top. The ten-line inscription runs around the cylindrical face. The *kufic* characters date from the AH 6th / AD 12th century.  
The text of the inscription reads (translation by M. Amari – see Bibliography): ‘In the name of God the merciful and compassionate. God bless the Prophet Muhammad and his offspring and give them peace. This is the tomb of ‘Umar ibn Abû Bakr ash-Sha’iri (the barley seller), who died on Monday the eighth of the month of Dhul Hijjah of the year \[five hundred\] and fifteen’.  
The Hegira year is missing the hundreds. On the basis of the coincidence of Monday and the eighth of the month, Amari suggests \[six hundred\] and fifteen, which would be AD 1219. Conversely, *Répertoire* (see Bibliography) suggests \[five hundred\] and fifteen, or AD 1122, which appears more justified in consideration of the style of the *kufic* characters.
The peculiar column shape of this stele suggests a very specific origin: southern Italy. Original examples of this type can be traced back to 10th-century Egypt.
keywords: kufic; calligraphy; funerary stele; funerary inscription; gravestone

es.name: Cipo de mármol con inscripción cúfica.
description:
Cipo cilíndrico de mármol, con la parte inferior deteriorada, sin decoración salvo una simple moldura en la parte superior. La inscripción, de 10 líneas, recorre la superficie cilíndrica. Los caracteres cúficos se remontan al siglo VI / XII.  
La inscripción reza, según la traducción de M. Amari, como sigue: “En el nombre de Dios el Misericordioso y Clemente. Que Dios bendiga al profeta Muhammad y a su estirpe y les conceda la paz. Esta es la sepultura de Umar ibn Abu Bakr al-Sha’iri \[“el vendedor de cebada”\], que murió el día lunes ocho del mes de du-l-hiyya del año \[quinientos\] quince”.  
En la determinación del año de la Hégira no se conservan las centenas. Amari, basándose en la coincidencia entre el lunes y el día 8 del mes, propone considerar \[seiscientos\] quince, lo cual situaría la fecha en 1219. En cambio, el *Répertoire* se inclina por \[quinientos\] quince, con una datación en 1122, hipótesis que, teniendo en cuanta el estilo de los caracteres cúficos, parece más atendible.
La peculiar forma de “columna” de esta estela funeraria determina su atribución a un marco geográfico muy preciso: la Italia meridional. El modelo entronca con ejemplares egipcios del siglo IV / X.
keywords: lápida funeraria; caracteres cúficos; estela funeraria; inscripción funeraria

fr.name: Cippe funéraire cylindrique en marbre avec inscription arabe en caractères coufiques.
description:
Cippe funéraire cylindrique en marbre, endommagé dans sa partie inférieure, sans décor, hormis une simple modénature dans la partie supérieure. L'inscription se déploie sur la surface cylindrique, sur dix lignes. Les caractères coufiques s'avèrent être du VIe siècle de l'Hégire (XIIe siècle J.-C.).  
Le texte de l'inscription est le suivant (d'après la traduction de M. Amari) : “Au nom de Dieu miséricordieux et clément. Que Dieu bénisse le prophète Mahomet et sa lignée et leur accorde la paix. Ceci est la sépulture d'Omar ibn Abou Bakr al-Cha'iri (le marchand d'orge), lequel est mort le lundi huit du mois de *dhul higgiah* de l'an (cinq cent) quinze.”  
Pour la détermination de l'année de l'Hégire, on ne conserve pas les centaines : sur la base de la correspondance entre le lundi et le 8 du mois, M. Amari propose d'intégrer (six cent) quinze, ce qui porterait la date à 1219 ; le *Répertoire*, par contre, propose d'intégrer (cinq cent) quinze, avec datation correspondant à 1122, ce qui semble plus justifié, compte tenu du style des caractères coufiques.

La typologie particulière “en colonnette” de cette stèle en détermine l'appartenance à un cadre géographique bien précis : l'Italie du Sud. Le prototype peut être repéré en Égypte, dans des pièces du Xe siècle.
keywords: stèle funéraire ; caractères coufiques; caractères coufiques; inscription funéraire ; pierre tombale

it.name: cippo funerario cilindrico in marmo con iscrizione araba in caratteri cufici.
description: cippo funerario cilindrico in marmo, danneggiato nella parte inferiore, senza decorazioni, a parte una semplice modanatura nella parte superiore. L'epigrafe si svolge sulla superficie cilindrica, per 10 righe. I caratteri cufici risultano di VI/XII secolo. Il testo dell'iscrizione è il seguente (traduzione di M. Amari): “Nel nome di Dio misericordioso e clemente. Benedica Dio il profeta Maometto e la sua stirpe e dia loro pace. Questa è la sepoltura di 'Umar ibn AbàBakr ash-Sha'iri (il venditore d'orzo), il quale è morto il lunedì, otto del mese di dhul higgiah dell'anno [cinquecento]quindici”. Nella determinazione dell'anno dell'Egira non si conservano le centinaia: in base alla coincidenza tra il lunedì e il giorno 8 del mese, l'Amari propone di integrare [seicento] quindici, il che porterebbe la data al 1219; il Répertoire invece propone di integrare [cinquecento] quindici, con relativa datazione al 1122, che, per lo stile dei caratteri cufici, sembra più giustificata.

La particolare tipologia “a colonnetta” di questa stele ne determina l'appartenenza ad un ambito geografico ben preciso: l'Italia del sud. Il prototipo può essere rintracciato in Egitto, in esemplari del X secolo.
keywords: stele funeraria; caratteri cufici; calligrafia; iscrizione funeraria; pietra tombale

en.name: Dodge Power Wagon
description:
This all-American truck stands out in Sheikh Faisal’s collection, having been passed down from his father Sheikh Qassim bin Faisal Al Thani. A trailer-unit, rope, and replacement tire equip the red Dodge Power-Wagon to surf along the desert dunes with ease.  
  
Out of the desire to teach the art of driving, Sheikh Faisal built a replica of the truck, which sits next to the original. Sheikh Faisal’s children would practice across Al Samriya estate with their father as their instructor.  
  
The Oryx antlers crown the front as reminders of the wagon’s past life in hunting activities with falcons. Today, a flair of nostalgia surrounds American trucks as Qataris associate these vehicles with the trodden local landscape.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani

en.name: Le minaret de la Grande Mosquée
names: The Minaret of the Great Mosque
description:
The only remnant of the city’s Great Mosque, the tall minaret dominates this site. It is a four-sided tower, measuring 24.70 metres high and 6.50 metres per side, still standing in the centre of the north side of the ruins. It is the second oldest mosque in Algeria, after the Mosque of Bou Merouane in Annaba. Inside, the upper part has collapsed; 127 steps revolve around a solid central core and lead to the top.  
  
Only the south face of the minaret, which overlooks the courtyard, is decorated. Its originality lies in its ornamentation in the form three vertical registers, a design unknown in Muslim art at that time, and later to be seen in the minaret of the Giralda of Seville. The central register of the facade is recessed and has the entry door with three window openings above, while the lateral niches, flat or semicylindrical, were decorated with sculpted plaster. The entrance was topped by a panel of limestone carved with interlacing stems, fleurons and palmettes, all motifs inspired by the Abbasid East and brought by visitors from there who were drawn by the reputation of the city.  
  
To the east of the site, in the district of Djawara, are the ruins of the Dungeon of Manar and those of the palace of the same name.

fr.name: Le minaret de la Grande Mosquée
description:
Seul vestige de la Grande Mosquée de la ville, le minaret domine le site de toute sa hauteur. C’est une tour parallélépipédique, toujours debout, mesurant 24,70 m de hauteur et 6,50 m de côté et se dressant au milieu du côté nord. Après celui de la mosquée de Boumerouane à Annaba, c’est le plus ancien d’Algérie. La partie supérieure s’est effondrée. Cent vingt-sept marches tournant autour d’un noyau central plein conduisent à sosommet. Seule la face sud du minaret, celle qui donnait sur la cour, est décorée. Son originalité réside dans son ornementation suivant trois registres verticaux, une configuration jusque-là inédite dans l’histoire de l’art musulman et qui se retrouvera plus tard au minaret de la Giralda de Séville. Le registre central est en retrait et se compose d’une porte et de trois fenêtres, tandis que les deux niches latérales, à fond plat ou semicylindrique, sont ornées de plâtre sculpté. La porte d’entrée était surmontée d’un panneau de pierre calcaire sculptée d’un décor d’entrelacs de tiges, de fleurons et palmettes, autant de motifs inspirés de l’Orient abbasside et apportés par les nombreux arrivants de ces contrées qu’attirait le rayonnement de la ville.  
  
À l’est du site, dans le quartier des Djawara, apparaissent les ruines du donjon du Manar et celles du palais du même nom.

en.name: Jacket
short_description: This small circumcision jacket from old Algiers is made of velvet from Gênes. It is decorated with a palm-leaf pattern and an acorn hanging between each pair of leaves. The sleeves and the edges of the jacket are decorated with a criss-cross pattern.

fr.name: Veste

À la jonction de deux feuilles de palmes pendent des glands. Les manches et la bordure de la veste présentent une décoration de lignes entrecroisées.

en.name: Seated Berber woman (Nailiya)
description:
The image depicts a Nailiya, a woman of the Berber tribe of the Ouled Naïl, in the south of Algeria. She is sitting among rich cushions, wearing a colourful silk dress and the jewels used to perform their traditional dance.  
The Nailiyat were independent women, free to marry men of their choosing. They moved to the cities in the North to earn money as dancers, in order to maintain their families in their community of origin. All this was not fully understood by Europeans. With the emergence of sex tourism these women were forced to introduce sexual content in their originally hieratic performance, and finally they were even considered as prostitutes by the French administration, in turn leading to being repudiated in their villages.  
Early photography contributed to forge this image of the Nailiyat in the European imagination.
keywords: Photography; Orientalism; Algeria; Women

en.name: Synagogue of Santa María la Blanca
description:
The synagogue is situated in the old Jewish Quarter, which even in the Muslim period was an independent district surrounded by its own wall, the *madinat al-yahud* or City of the Jews. During the late Middle Ages it was called the *Judería Mayor*, or the main Jewish Quarter. It was one of the most famous in Castile and existed until the expulsion of the Jews in 1492. There are documentary references to various synagogues in Toledo and this must have been one of them. From 1401 onwards when it was consecrated as a Christian church, it was dedicated to and called Santa María, but among the names cited in texts before this date the name for this building has not been definitely identified. Probably it was the *Sinagoga Mayor* or Main Synagogue, or perhaps the *Sinagoga Nueva* or New Synagogue. Whichever is the case, an examination of its artistic features dates it to the first half of the 13th century.  
Santa María la Blanca is a unique building that attracts much discussion as to whether to consider it Almohad or Mudéjar. The opinion that it is Almohad is based upon the evident parallelisms it has with other works from the Almohad period. The opinion that it is Mudéjar, which has become the generally accepted one in recent years, points out that not only is it from Toledo, which was already under Christian domination, but also that it is related to other Mudéjar buildings of Castile in the Monastery of Las Huelgas in Burgos.  
Enclosed within plain exterior walls, the interior, on an irregular rectangular ground plan, divides into five aisles separated by horseshoe arches, drawn on a circumference very similar to those of San Román. However, the visual impression here is completely different because of the presence on the low pillars of large stuccowork capitals decorated with enormous pinecones, which Gómez-Moreno called “*a sovereign invention*” of the master carver who worked them. Both above and around the arches is delicate ornamentation mixing plant and geometric motifs, outstanding among which are the medallions with different strapwork designs. At the end of the aisles a sanctuary was introduced formed from three chapels, its interior decorated in the Renaissance style, and probably made between 1550 and 1556 and attributed to Alonso de Covarrubias.

es.name: Sinagoga de Santa María la Blanca
description:
Está situada en la antigua judería, que ya en época musulmana era un barrio independiente rodeado por su propia muralla, la *madinat al-yahud o ciudad de los judíos. Durante la Baja Edad Media se denominó Judería Mayor. Fue una de las más famosas de Castilla y se mantuvo hasta la expulsión de los judíos en 1492. Hay referencias documentales a la existencia de varias sinagogas en Toledo, y una de ellas tuvo que ser esta. Desde 1401, en que fue consagrada como templo cristiano, se la conoce por la advocación de Santa María, pero entre los nombres citados en los textos anteriores a esa fecha, el que tuvo esta no ha podido ser identificado con seguridad. Es probable que se trate de la sinagoga Mayor o de la sinagoga Nueva. En todo caso, un examen de sus rasgos artísticos la sitúa dentro de la primera mitad del siglo XIII.  
Santa María la Blanca es un edificio singular respecto del cual se discute también sobre si es obra almohade o mudéjar. La primera opinión se basa en los evidentes paralelismos que guarda con obras del período almohade, y la segunda, que se ha generalizado en los últimos años, atiende no solo al hecho de que está ubicada en un Toledo ya bajo dominio cristiano, sino también a la relación con otras construcciones mudéjares castellanas localizadas en el monasterio de las Huelgas de Burgos.  
Encerrado por un exterior de paramentos lisos, el espacio interior, de planta rectangular algo irregular, se divide en cinco naves separadas por arcos de herradura trazados sobre una circunferencia, muy similares a los de San Román. Sin embargo la impresión visual resulta totalmente distinta, por la presencia sobre bajos pilares de grandes capiteles de estuco decorados con enormes piñas, que Gómez-Moreno calificó de “invención soberana” del maestro que hizo la obra. Rodeando los arcos y por encima de ellos, una delicada ornamentación cubre los paramentos, mezclando los motivos vegetales con otros geométricos, entre los que destacan unos medallones con diferentes trazas de lacería. A estas naves se incorporó una cabecera formada por tres capillas con revestimiento interior renacentista, obra realizada entre 1550 y 1556, y atribuida a Alonso de Covarrubias.*

en.name: Beirut Evangelical School for Girls and Boys
description: Beirut Evangelical School is located in Rabiye, a wealthy area in Metn, Mount Lebanon. The school covers all levels from nursery, to elementary, intermediate and secondary schooling. It consists of two large buildings that house all the school's classes, laboratories, offices and administration, as well as a church and the administrative Synod Building of Syria and Lebanon. The facades are covered in a yellow and blue coating.
history: The Beirut Evangelical School for Girls and Boys is one of the oldest educational institutions in Lebanon, first founded in 1835. It has its roots in the first school for girls founded in west Beirut in 1828 by the early American Presbyterian missionaries to Greater Syria. In 1959, the Presbyterian Church in the USA transferred to the National Evangelical Synod of Syria and Lebanon and who henceforth were responsible for the running of all the educational institutions in the area that had been founded by American Presbyterian missionaries.

en.name: The Ottoman Bank
short_description: One of the world's largest photo archives, Abdülhamid II's photo archives – knows as the Yildiz Albums – contain about 37 thousand pictures from that period of the Ottoman Empire. The photo archives contain images of cities, buildings which were built by sultan, schools, students, soldiers, mosques, ports, government departments, shipyards, railways, bridges, bazaars, machines, locomotives and factories. The Ottoman Bank was founded in 1856 in the Galata business section of Istanbul, the capital of the Ottoman Empire, as a joint venture between British interests, the Banque de Paris et des Pays-Bas of France, and the Ottoman government. *Tanzimat* era's principal renovations in the financial field were the reestablishment of the currency and the foundation of the Ottoman Bank.
